articleTitle: Simulation of microwave drying in pyramidal chamber
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The mathematical model, the effectivity method and calculation program of non-stationary drying process of material in a pyramidal MWF chamber are developed.

publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is 75-year anniversary of Fyodor Pavlovich Korshunov a specialist in the field of solid-state radiation physics, Doctor of Science, Professor, Corresponding Member of NAS of Belarus, laureate of Belarus State Prize. A brief biography is provided.

articleTitle: To the 60-year anniversary of Professor Jozef Modelski
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology

articleTitle: Space-diversity reception as queueing system with mixed priority
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of application system mass service with mixed priority for efficiency estimation of space-time radio reception system is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Discrete attenuator with parallel connection of cells — the way for dynamic range expansion without deterioration of radar-tracking receiver sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Symmetric and asymmetrical schemes of an attenuator with the parallel connection of cells which allows increasing a dynamic range of the receiver without deterioration of its sensitivity are developed and their rough parameters are given. The analysis of modern microwave components shows possibility of creation (in the simplest case) of an asymmetrical attenuator with the parallel connection of cells with depth of attenuation about 60-70 dB, insertion loss 1.5 dB, a maximum level of RF signal of 2 W, in a range of frequencies DC-26.5 GHz.

articleTitle: Design of L-, S- and C-band low noise amplifires with input stages protection
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of design of the low-noise amplifiers (LNA) with protection of input stages operating over the bandwidth 3.0 to 7.0 GHz are presented. LNA are developed by NPP ldquoPlaneta-Argallrdquo. LNA can be used in entrance sections of communication equipment, radar stations, radars and radiation detectors.

articleTitle: To the 80-year anniversary of Professor Lipatov Anatoly Alekseyevich
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On 7 April, 2009 Anatoly Alekseyevich Lipatov, Candidate of Science, the leading scientist of SC at Ukraine Ministry of Defense, Professor of Telecommunications Department at UNTU "KPI,"Professor of Communications Media Department of NTUU, Kiev Polytechnical University has celebrated his 80-year anniversary. The most significant dates of his life are noted.

articleTitle: On-line microwave measurement of crude oil water content
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Microwave method and devices for on-line measurement of water content of crude oil are proposed. The method is based on measurement of microwave power propagated through transmission line and reflected from the load that is TEM-line resonator, search of extremes at the diagram that is dependence of relative reflected power on frequency and determination of coordinates (relative power, frequency) of these extremes. Two devices were realized for the measuring ranges (0...20) % and (10...100) % of water content. Corresponding sensors are coaxial line filled in by low-loss dielectric with sectorial flowed-through channel and twisted dielectrically coated two-wire line.

articleTitle: Radiation effects in bipolar transistors baised on silicon - germanium heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Ionizing radiation effects upon the properties of bipolar transistors on silicon-germanium heterostructures are investigated.

articleTitle: Test and measurement system for microwave semiconductor devices and IC investigation on radiation hardness
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Test and measurement system for microwave semiconductor devices and IC's investigation on radiation hardness has been presented and described.

articleTitle: Gan solid-state microwave power amplifiers — State-of-the-art and future trends
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The world technical achievements and tendencies in the development of GaN microwave transistors, MMICs and high power amplifiers are considered. The objective of this work is an analysis of state-of-the-art GaN microwave discrete transistors, MMICs and high power (10...100 Watt and more) amplifiers, parameters and basic tendencies in the development of GaN devices. Major properties of wideband gap semiconductors available for microwave transistors are presented in table 1. The highest energy gap, availability of high temperature and high radiation environment, an extremely high density of sheet carrier, higher electric fields and breakdown voltages result in 310 W/mm and more output power density of practical released microwave GaN transistors. Table 2 shows the main parameters of broadband (without internal matching circuits) GaN power transistors. The properties of WCDMA 120 W power transistors (Si LDMOS, GaAs MESFET and GaN HEMT) are compared in table 3. The typical density (for 1 mm gate) of various GaN and GaAs HEMT transistor parameters, including optimal load density, is presented in table 4. Many projects and MMIC topologies, designed for GaAs MMICs might be transferred with minimal corrections into the GaN MMICs based on equal or on (20...50) % wider gate of transistors with x(5-10) corresponding output power (see fig. 1). The main parameters of industrial and laboratorial GaN MMIC technologies are presented in table 5, table 6 shows parameters of commercially available and lab released GaN MMICs. Fig. 2 presents the last five years of an evolution of the pulse output power of X-band GaN MMIC amplifiers for future radar systems with phased array. The parameters of the ultra-wideband GaN high power amplifiers up to 6 GHz are presented in table 7, figure 3 shows the chip sizes of the highest power of X-band GaN and GaAs MMIC amplifiers. In the decade ahead (1...50) GHz frequency range will be a topic of arguing between two power microwave technologies. One of them is a high performance and a high cost of GaN technology, the second-low cost and widely used in the industry of GaAs technology.

articleTitle: Development of up-to-date laboratory base for microprocessor systems investigation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Principles of design of laboratory facilities for learning microprocessor technology in technics are proposed. Modern laboratory base for studying the microprocessor, microcontroller and FPGA systems is described.

articleTitle: Features of long term evolution technology and comparative analysis of noise stability for different kinds of modulation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The reasons of occurrence of technologies of the fourth generation, the basic requirements for them, and features of construction of LTE technology are considered in article. The transceiver for a line LtdownlinkGtfor time division duplex of a channel is considered. The scheme, showing dependence of the signal-noise ratio for different kinds of modulation is considered.

articleTitle: Devices for autodyne signals registration in Gunn diode oscillators
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: One of the most valuable advantages of autodyne SRR (short-range radar) structure is the possibility of implementation of miniature effective lightweight transceivers at rather high sensitivity and energy potential. This possibility is particularly effective in application for SRR on the basis of modern Gunn diode (GD) oscillators. It is shown in some publications that in Gunn diode oscillators the diode current at output short-circuit is the optimal autodyne signal parameter for registration, i.e. when the oscillator supply is arranged from the voltage source. This condition can be fulfilled with registration devices offered in this paper, which use the function of "current-voltage" converter and provide the improved noise performance of the autodyne system.

articleTitle: Wide-band antenna for on-body RFID application
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the paper the design and simulated features of antenna intended for on-body UHF RFID application are proposed. Effects of antenna dimensions and material properties are studied and the optimal design is chosen. The antenna is matched to the chip with impedance 73-i113 Ohm. It is shown that the antenna when attached onto the human body is operable within the frequency range 866-956 GHz that covers all frequency bands stated for UHF RFID devices.

articleTitle: Sevastopol range for measuring radar, thermal and laser properties of surface ships (1979–1991)
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Described in this paper is the history of creation of Sevastopol ground for testing radar, heat and laser properties of surface crafts. The review of the testing ground activity and biography of its research supervisor D.Sc. Ye. Shtager is presented. The questions regarding researches noncompletion because of the USSR collapse are discussed.

articleTitle: Approach to data processing in information-telecommunication environment of complex administrative systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The approach of information processing in information-telecommunication environment of complex management systems is proposed. The proposed approach allows increasing of efficiency of procedure of data processing.

articleTitle: Standing wave magnetic patterns of water exposed to UHF sinusoidal electromagnetic radiation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Standing wave magnetic patterns (SWMP) surrounding water samples exposed to UHF sinusoidal electromagnetic radiation are discovered. It is assumed that the SWM patterns obtained at resonant frequencies of 384 and 386.4 MHz relate to a layer charge structure of nucleons.

articleTitle: A 2 GS/s 450 MHz bandpass ΔΣ modulator for switch-mode power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a fourth order bandpass delta-sigma modulator (BDSM) for a signal carrier of 450 MHz, sampled at 2 GHz. Designed and fabricated in 0.25 mum SiGe BiCMOS technology the modulator achieves 42,2 dB signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in 20 MHz bandwidth with sine wave input while consuming 330 mW from a 3.3 V supply. Measurement results show that the circuit is well suited for transmitting signals with a non-constant envelope and can be used as a driver for class-S power amplifiers. For a CDMA modulated signal the modulator demonstrates an error-vector magnitude (EVM) less than 2,7 %.

articleTitle: Using circularly polarized waves for small elongated objects detection in microwave imaging
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An experimental research for small elongated objects' detection in microwave imaging with circularly polarized wave is presented. It is shown that with circularly polarized wave it is possible to detect the elongated objects regardless orientation of the objects, and it is possible to determine object direction in this case. Also, it is experimentally proven that the field scattered from an elongated object highly depends on illuminating wave polarization direction even when the object size is comparable with the to wave length.

articleTitle: Scanners for near-field microwave microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The description of methods and facilities of microwave near-field microscopy and the radiophysical equipment designed within the framework of scientific and technical cooperation is given. The results of model experiments, amplitude and phase pictures of optically opaque objects by using the near-field technique are considered at frequencies of (40...140) GHz.

articleTitle: The study of matched coaxial microwave adapter of instrumental grade
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Matched adapters between 7/3.04 mm and 3.5/1.52 mm coaxial transmission lines, providing accepted value of modulus of radiant reflectance not worse than -40 dB, are studied. Investigated adapters are serially produced by Research and Production Company ldquoMicranrdquo.

articleTitle: Broadband loop antenna
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the paper a broadband flat loop antenna of linear polarization with two antiphase feed sources is presented. The possibility of expansion of a frequency band for the wide flat loop antenna through the use of two groups of nondissipative stubs, working accordingly on the top and the bottom band boundaries is shown.

articleTitle: The role of Belarus in CriMiCo organization (1992–2008)
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analyzed in this paper is the participation of different Belarusian scientists and specialists in CriMiCo organization for the period 1992-2008. Three aspects are considered: participation in the work of the committees, publications, organization of the committee sessions in Minsk (Belarus), personalia. The methods of bibliometric analysis are used.

articleTitle: Distributed computation of space charge field of relativistic electron beam
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calculation of the space charge field in high-current relativistic electron beams using the particle-to-particle method is considered. A new limit for calculation, which allows taking the particle velocity into account, is presented. Different variants of modeling systems are discussed.

articleTitle: Time-delayed generators application for secure information transmission on the basis of generalized synchronization
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Method for secure information transmission based on generalized synchronization in the presence of noise is considered. Characteristics of chaotic systems used in transmitters and receivers are analyzed. Models of generators with delayed feedback, possessing all necessary requirements are revealed.

articleTitle: Unipole radiation in magnetic crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The rigorous analytical expressions for electromagnetic waves in magnetic crystals radiated by the unbalanced vibrator were obtained. Diagrams were adduced for near-field and for far-field regions.

articleTitle: Even and odd sampling for simulation of electron devices with irregular electrodynamic systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of even sampling for solution of the ordinary differential equation is proposed. Its high efficiency is demonstrated as an example of the propagation of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> - mode in an irregular waveguide with a circular section.

articleTitle: Microstrip frequency-separating device on travelling-wave ring resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A micro-strip multichannel frequency-separating device based on directional filters of a travelling-wave has been considered. The parameters of the (8,0...11) GHz two-channel device have been given.

articleTitle: Sensors with biconical microwave cavity for dielectric characterization
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of consumption of the biconical cavity-based sensors for characterization of dielectric materials is calculated. Oriented the reckoning, a biconical cavity is made, and experimental investigations of its characteristics under interaction with dielectric materials are conducted.

articleTitle: Spatial structure effect on MIMO communication systen capacity
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The mobile communication system designed on MIMO principles is discussed. Radiowave propagation is considered in conditions of line of sight (LOS). In the case of LOS a considerable benefit is obtained. Effective spatial structure of transmitting and receiving systems is proposed for the LOS channels.

articleTitle: Hatching of eggs of artemia and change of chromatin state under the influence of electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of ultra wideband pulse radiation and microwave radiation (frequency 36, 64 GGHz) was investigated. The power density of ultra wideband pulse radiation was 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>, 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup>, 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>, 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, the power density of microwave radiation - 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. articleTitle: Comparative analysis of web-site content management systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this work the method of selection of software of management systems of content (CMS) the most relevant to requirements of different types of resources created by information systems is proposed. At the same time the effort to sum up in aggregated form the requirements to Web resources of various orientations (the site-presentation, a theme site, blog, portal, community site, etc.) is made. On the other hand, the functions of the most popular CMS in order to highlight their groups and use as evaluation criteria are analyzed. It is used to determine the best correspondence of content management system to requirements of Web resources that are possible to create with certain CMS.

articleTitle: TWT frequency characteristics in submillimeter range
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The TWT mathematical model on wavy bent rectangular waveguide is described taking into account losses and dielectric filling of a waveguide. Features of formation of TWT frequency characteristics in submillimeter range are noted. The reasons of TWT self-excitation are analyzed and methods of its suppression are offered.

articleTitle: Two-cascade DRO of 1.5 mm wave range on second space harmonic
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The outcomes of experimental examination of the 1.5-mm wave range diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) with field phase inversion of the open resonant system in the middle of interaction space are brought. The application advantages of two-cascade interaction space at DRO operation on the higher spatial harmonics in comparison with homogeneous diffraction grating are shown.

articleTitle: The process of information publication on scientific online resources
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Existent solutions for work process automation in companies were analyzed. Problem-solving techniques of internal document management were suggested to improve the efficiency of team-work.

articleTitle: Near-field microwave probe on the basis of cone coaxial resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In present work a model of microwave probe based on the cone coaxial resonator is considered. The numeric evaluation of influence of aperture radius on field distribution in diagnosed object is fulfilled and dependence of initial high quality on operating frequency in certain frequency range is explained.

articleTitle: Functionality of wireless network design tools
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The presented work examines a class of deployed propagation models and algorithms for wireless network design as well as evaluates the elaborated functionality for a wireless network design tool, CANDY Site Finder [1...3]. The mentioned software is developed in 2006-2009. CANDY Site Finder has been compared with the well-known systems Ekahau Site Survey [4] and RF3D WiFi Planner [5]. The delivered results confirm a good compliance of the theoretical expectations and practical values. The further achievement options for CANDY Site Finder are formulated.

articleTitle: Waveguide-microstrip transition for 60 GHz frequency band
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper the design of waveguide-to-microstrip transition for 60 GHz frequency band is considered. The design is made using standard printed-circuit technique and allows a direct connection of the WR-15 waveguide without additional modifications in the structure of a waveguide. The parameters of the transition confirmed by the experimental measurements are 11.5% frequency bandwidth (at -10 dB level of the reflection index) and insertion loss less than 1.5 dB.

articleTitle: Overview of a Model-to-Code transformation approach for generating Service-based interactive applications for Google Android
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper reports on an approach for generating interactive applications for Google Android within a model-driven development chain. The described model-to-code transformation is used within a methodology applying a visual authoring approach of interactive applications upon service infrastructures. The central contribution of this paper is a proof-of-concept that the meta-model developed for this approach to describe complete service-based interactive applications and intended to express models close to the final platforms can be applied to the generation of fat clients running on mobile devices.

articleTitle: Optimal parameters for Ka-band low-voltage magnetron with secondary-emission cathode
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analytical estimation of optimal parameters of pulse magnetron of 8 mm-band with cool secondary-emission cathode operating under 6.5 kV anode voltage in the mode of drift-orbital resonance has been performed. Ability of the magnetron with analytically determined parameters to maintain the required energy characteristics is checked by the use of computational and 3D-simulation experiment. The possibility is shown to develop a functional magnetron with relatively low anode voltage and parameters that assure its wide range of application.

articleTitle: Wideband L-S band SiC power amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of engineering and a research of wideband L-S band (0,5...2,5) GHz amplifiers with CW output power from 20 to 200 Watt based on SiC-MESFETS are presented. It is included: (0,5...1) GHz (PM051) amplifier with output powers (182...269) W and efficiency (20...32) %; (0,8...1,6) GHz (PM0816) amplifier with output powers (117...137) W and efficiency (26...33) %; (0,8...2,5) GHz (PM0825-1) amplifier with output powers (21,5...27,8) W and efficiency (14...20) %. Fig. 1 and fig. 3 show output balanced chains of an amplifier.

articleTitle: An annotation tool for enhancing the user interface generation process for services
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The user interface generation process is still a complex issue. The manual creation process is time consuming and complex because it requires the combination of the application developer work and the user interface designer work. Therefore, many approaches investigate the automatic user interface generation. However, currently such approaches are not able to take usability aspects into account, due to the lack of information for such a process. Thus, we propose a tool which intends to ease and enhance the automatic user interface generation process for services by introducing service annotations that are attached to services and provide additional information for the process of automatic user interface generation.

articleTitle: Design of solid state 0.5/1 kW C-band transmitter with 1∶1 redundancy and combining configuration
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Powerful 1 kW C-band transmitter for satellite communication was designed and tested. A flexible redundancy-combining configuration lets providers to combine power of two transmitters in heavy communication traffic or use one of the transmitters in redundant configuration to keep high reliability of a system.

articleTitle: Influence of strong electrolyte on characteristics of double-layered electromagnetic shields with gel-powder fillers
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of affix of strong electrolyte on reflection index and transmission coefficient of electromagnetic emission of liquid-containing double-layered electromagnetic shields is studied.

articleTitle: Estimation of synchronization influence on VHF oscillators susceptibility to external effects
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the present article the method of susceptibility estimation of VHF generators to external effects is offered on the basis of known results, it is shown that synchronization reduces levels of side radiations of generators at penetration into them interferences approximately for 6 dB at the synchronization signal ratio to interference equal to 1.

articleTitle: Integral equation method for analyzing wire antennas coated by a layer of ideal magnetic
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A modified version of Pocklington integral equation is proposed for solving the tasks of excitation and scattering of thin-wire antennas coated with a layer of magnetodielectric. The influence of such a coating on the scattering characteristics of dipole antennas is investigated.

articleTitle: MM-wave linear tuning oscillator on the basis of DDS technology
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The oscillator is intended for a short range of CW radar. The DDS technology was used to provide a reference signal for MM wave length of PLL circuit. The output frequency was 32-38 GHz, the output power was 13 dBm, and the total nonlinearity was no more 0.5%. The phase noise was less than -85 dBc/Hz & 10 kHz.

articleTitle: Design of small-size bandpass filters on magnetostatic spin waves in UHF band
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of designing of small-sized PBF on MSW in frequency band (0,8...3,0) GHz are presented. Characteristic curve of PBF parameters versus saturation magnetization of structures of yttrium iron garnet is analyzed. Two types of magnetic systems that provide tuning of amplitude-frequency characteristics of PBF in the operating band are developed. Merits of magnetic system with inductance coils and constant magnets in comparison with magnetic systems provided only with inductance coils are shown.

articleTitle: Diode with cathode static domain as the source of HF-noise
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The diode, in which the cathodic static domain is formed under certain conditions, where at the big pressure shock ionization can develop, is considered. Occurrence of shock ionization leads to avalanche transit-time effect and occurrence of noise generation. It is shown below, at what pressure on the GaAs-diode it is possible to get the electric field intensity in such a domain about 200 kV/cm. Comparing the received calculation results with earlier received experimental results for the same lengths of diodes, it is possible to notice that experimental values of pressure at which shock ionization begins, approximately twice less than design values. It testifies that in cathode areas the material characteristics of GaAs differ from bulk properties of GaAs. Indeed, in experimental diodes the low-doped area represented semi-isolating arsenide of gallium which, as it is known, is got as a result of electronic GaAs alloying by chrome (Cr). Such material should have low mobility of carriers of a charge (less than 3000 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/V s) and dependence of drift speed distinct from the volume of electrons and holes vs. electric field intensity.

articleTitle: Operation principle of intro-pulse autodyne FM SRR
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper shows the functional circuit of short-range radar (SRR) with pulse modulation and FM. Time diagrams of such SRR output signals are also presented. The modulation pulse parameters and gating parameters, their interposition in time are defined in the synchronization unit. At the same unit, the synchronization of pulse modulation processes and FM is provided. The radiation reflected from a target inside of each radio pulse causes the amplitude and frequency variations due to the autodyne effect as well as the bias voltage variations after time T later on the beginning of the radio pulse formation. The amplitude variations are usually extracted by means of the additional (external) detector, but the bias voltage variations in the oscillator supply circuit.

articleTitle: Transceiving modules with Luneberg lens for radar systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Transmit-receive modules with Luneberg lens for radar system is considered in the present report. New experimental data are described.

articleTitle: Helix TWT with dielectric correction of slowing
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The helix TWT is offered with dielectric cores for the helix fixing, the cores are made of a material with dielectric permittivity changing along an interaction area as per the stated law providing the required smooth law of change of delay and efficiency increase.

articleTitle: Analysis of SAR Instrument Response in transceiver network and TRM prototype tests
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The test methods of SAR of instrument response function (InRF), using a biphase modulation of outgoing pulses are introduced. The results of investigation of SAR transceiver with a TRM of antenna array are presented.

articleTitle: Automation and the features regarding satellite communication network coordination
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method of dispatching of satellite communication networks with the use of respective software and of ITU Radiocommunication Bureau (ITU-R is presented). The calculations results for Ukraine are shown.

articleTitle: Safety problems in nanotechnology
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The experience of leading countries in ensuring the safety of nanotechnology production has been analyzed; recommendations for perfecting the nanosafety system in Russia have been formulated.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic waves scattering on a lattice of Dielectric Resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: There are given investigation results of scattering of electro-magnetic waves on square lattices of Dielectric Resonators (DR) with magnetic resonance H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">101</sub>. The criterions were quantified, running which the behavior of lattice had been defined with negative index of refraction. In the wave zone scattering, coefficients of scattering matrix, amplitudes of coupled and forced oscillations were counted.

articleTitle: Using of Hilbert transform for analyzing nonstationary processes of electroencephalogramm type
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of electroencephalogram (EEG) analysis with the support of the Hilbert phase-frequency analysis is under consideration.

articleTitle: Optimization of wireless backbone network access structure
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A solution of a problem of optimization of places of disposition and structure of access of base stations of wireless fidelity in the process of modernization of telecommunication networks is described.

articleTitle: Technical and economic optimization of construction and operation of mobile WiMAX networks
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principle of choice of a business model of construction and operation of WiMax network is considered, the variant of construction wireless WiMax network is offered with application of a wholesale model.

articleTitle: Ferrite perovskite composite materials for correction of radiating systems' parameters
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principles of production of ferromagnetic materials with spinel structure and ferroelectrics with perovskite structure with a high level of susceptibility and small losses of a field used to shorten the aerial sizes and to correct a wavefront curvature are presented.

articleTitle: Enhancement of electrical and chemical surface properties of titanium and iron-carbon alloys irradiated with a low-energy intense pulsed electron beam
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Processes leading to homogenization of chemical and phase composition of near-surface layers materials made from titanium and iron-carbon alloys under irradiation of a low-energy intense pulsed electron beam have been investigated. It has been shown that preliminary heating leads to appearance of a more homogeneous chemical composition of surface alloy. It has been determined that an electron-beam polishing took place during irradiation. Irradiation results in dissolution of secondary phase inclusions, decreasing of roughness, and as a result in the enhancement of electrical and chemical surface properties of titanium and iron-carbon alloys.

articleTitle: Forecasting ic stability at the effect of power pulse electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of predictive modeling of resistability of modern microcircuits at influence of powerful pulse electromagnetic fields on the basis of experimental data and numerically-analytical model are discussed.

articleTitle: Measuring device of complex VSWR of millimeter waves by the example of 8-ports circuit
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of measuring device's properties of complex VSWR on the basis of a double T-junction is offered. The theoretical equations for determination of parameters of the studied device were carried out.

articleTitle: Calculation-experimental technique for microwave diode limiters design
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new method of designing of microwave diode limiters has been tested; the obtained results have been compared with experimental data.

articleTitle: Complex analysis of Ku-band dielectric resonator filters for 50–100 W applications
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of the complex analysis (electrical and thermal) of the resonant sections for Ku-band dielectric resonator filters (input power 50 W...100 W) are discussed.

articleTitle: Increasing of operational capabilities for definition boundaries of emergency situations zones using global satellite systems of radio navigation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of increasing efficiency for definition boundaries of emergency situations zone, based on satellite systems of the radio navigation, is shown.

articleTitle: Subterahertz double-mode O-type oscillation source
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The nonlinear multidimensional theory of the subterahertz O-type dual-mode source on the basis of the distributed self-reactance modulation of electron beam by BWO oscillations and amplification of diffraction radiation on the harmonics of BWO frequency is developed. Numerical investigations of output characteristics of BWO oscillator and parametric amplifier of diffraction radiation are performed.

articleTitle: Open resonator with trapezoidal mirror for terahertz DRO
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For the two-dimensional open resonator (OR) with a trapezoidal mirror and a flat mirror covered with a reflective diffraction grating, the examinations of a spectrum and Q-factor of excited modes are carried out. The advantages of the trapezoidal mirror are shown in comparison with a spherical mirror for shaping an extended interaction space in terahertz (THz) frequency range. The outcomes of scale experiment in 10-mm waveband of mode selection in OR are presented.

articleTitle: Ambiguity bodies analysis for simple soundings signals of radioacoustic systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article suggests a notion of ambiguity function for scattered signals of radioacoustic atmosphere sounding. The ambiguity bodies of simple probing signals are procured. The article gives an analysis of potential accuracy of atmosphere characterization by the type and nature of changes in ambiguity bodies of posed signals, depending on the value of detuning of Bragg condition, in which a scattered signal is formed.

articleTitle: Analysis of efficiency of digital image restoration methods using MATLAB cad
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analysis of efficiency of digital image restoration methods by means of MATLAB is performed. Examples of image reconstruction are given, disadvantages of acquainted methods and ways of their solution are observed.

articleTitle: Calculation of post-solid state electrons energy spectrum using Monte-Carlo method
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The algorithm is developed, the program of modeling of electron transporting using a method of Monte-Carlo is developed for a case of their birth as solid bodies. Power spectra of the escaped particles are constructed. The method of Monte-Carlo in two variants was used: with application of approach of continuous delay and with modeling of not elastic collisions. It is shown that though the dispersion of passage at use of different approaches is rather considerable, it influences probability of an exit of electrons from a target insignificantly, but essentially changes a high-energy part of a power spectrum of escaped electrons.

articleTitle: Digital antenna array calibraition
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calibration of a phased array antenna while the antenna is in service can be a complex and time-consuming procedure that affects use of the antenna and imposes an unacceptable overhead for the system. The procedure described herein uses a maximum likelihood algorithm to minimize the number of measurements, thus reducing the impact on the system and shifting the additional calculations to a processing unit.

articleTitle: The theory of plasma-beam superheterodyne free electron laser with H-ubitron pumping
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The nonlinear quadratic theory of plasma-beam superheterodyne free electron laser with H-ubitron pumping is presented. Multi-harmonious interaction of waves is taken into consideration. Analysis of the growth increment for the signal electromagnetic wave is carried out. It is found that prospects of practical use of the considered systems for generation of especially powerful electromagnetic signals of the mm range could be rather promising.

articleTitle: Microstrip patch antenna with metallodielectric electromagnetic crystals as a substrate
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of a substrate of metallodielectric electromagnetic crystals on properties of microstrip planar antennas is theoretically investigated. Simulations made by means of 3D FDTD code have revealed that the use of such substrates might greatly improve performances of existing antennas.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic waves influence on liquid passing through a capillary
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possible mechanism of effect of change of the charge of a liquid current on a round pipe, under effect of the external electromagnetic field is offered.

articleTitle: Transformed optical and electronic equipment kit for new-born babies and suckling infants
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The designed kit of the transformed optical and electronic equipment, ensuring creation of the pediatricians working place, securing the comfort conditions to perform the medical procedures with the newly-born children and suckling infants, including the medical examination, diagnostic procedures, sanitation and medicine treatment, light therapy, massage and other physiotherapeutic procedures, is presented. The kit comprises the metal support with the cradle for a baby, a multi-range optical module, a temperature sensor, a microcontroller, a device of the emergency alarm. The kit has passed the hygienic and clinical tests and is implemented into the medical practice in a large number of Belarusian and Russian medical institutions.

articleTitle: New method of network capacity increasing
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The ways of efficiency upgrading of a system of digital data transmission are considered in the article. A new method of increasing of number of channels on one frequency is suggested. It allows enhancing of data transmission rate and interference immunity.

articleTitle: Matrixes of field emission cathodes based on carbon nanotubes in porous anodic alumina
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The process of formation of cold cathodes on the basis of carbon nanotubes synthesized in porous anodic alumina has been developed. Integral and local field emission (FE) measurements of produced cathodes have been performed. Main FE parameters: onset field, field enhancement factor and current capability of certain emitters have been measured.

articleTitle: Ultra low phase noise in CK4-Belan 240 spectrum analyzer
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The comparative analysis of performance of an ultralow phase noise for various high-end spectrum analyzers is presented. The new 1<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ST</sup> LO scheme of the spectrum analyzer CK4-Belan 240/280 is discussed.

articleTitle: Metrological characteristics of microwave multiprobe multimeter
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of error calculation of microwave multiprobe multimeter with equidistant location of sensors was considered in the report. The correlation between the interface variables was taken into account during evaluation, what allowed achieving of more precise result of evaluation.

articleTitle: Mode selection of “whispering gallery” kind in dielectric circular disk resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the present paper the influence of a diffraction periodic grating upon a spectrum of fluctuations of ldquowhispering galleryrdquo type of a dielectric disk resonator is theoretically and experimentally studied for the first time. Conditions of one-mode excitation in a wide interval of frequencies are defined. Good coincidence of theoretical and experimental results is obtained.

articleTitle: Virtual nonlinear impulse network analyzer for Microwave Office
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The library cell for CAD system Microwave Office, that allows carrying out the virtual measurements of the nonlinearity characteristic of the individual elements and networks, using baseband pulse and ultra-wideband test signals, is considered. The device measures both transfer characteristics and the reflectogram. The example of using of the virtual measuring device is considered. The results of virtual measurements are compared with experimental data which was obtained by the example of investigation of transmission line with linear and nonlinear discontinuities.

articleTitle: Excitation of TE01 wave mode in the fragment of coaxial line being a part of open resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The work is dedicated to research of hemispherical open resonator (OR) with a fragment of a coaxial line in the centre of a flat reflector. Excitation efficiency of TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> wave mode of such waveguide via TEM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01q</sub> oscillation mode of OR is analyzed. Excitation efficiency amount of 97% is demonstrated. On the ground of conducted analysis, availability of such resonance system for compression microwave energy of millimeter wave length range is discussed.

articleTitle: Two-aerial modulation radiometer
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The two-antenna modulation radiometer, which allows providing reliable detection of local structural infringements in sites of an object due to comparison of radio thermal radiation from basic and investigated sites of objects, is offered. The radiometer function chart, a principle and an algorithm of signal processing are considered.

articleTitle: Thick-electron beam klinoorbotron
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of developed program considering deposition of current on the slow-wave structure (SWS) the optimal parameters of a 3-mm wave orbotron and klinoorbotron operating at voltage of an electron beam of 3-kV have been calculated. The stratification effect of a beam in orbotron has been studied. It has been shown that the use of klinotron effect results in efficient compensation of stratification.

articleTitle: Analysis of interference re-reflections in MIMO radar at multiplicative processing
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The mathematical model of influence of rereflections is presented for a small range radar with a step frequency modulation signal and for a spatially multi-channel antenna system of MIMO type. Presence and level of interferential marks in the system alarm function are analyzed for a multiplicative algorithm of processing for all pairs of ldquotransmitter-receiverrdquo elements.

articleTitle: The influence of electrodynamic system ohmic losses in 1mm wavelength orotron on its efficiency and output power
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of the 1-mm wavelength orotron optimization at 6 kV voltage operating on the second space harmonic of two row periodic structure (TRPS) are presented. The computer simulation methods of the electron-wave interaction efficiency increase, which were developed for orotron at long-wavelength range, are used. The spherocylinder was used as a focusing mirror. The cylinder longitudinal axis was perpendicular to the electron beam direction. The optimal TRPS length dependence on ohmic losses in an open resonator for maximum orotron efficiency is found. The calculations were carried out on the basis of the results obtained in paper [1]. It was shown that the quality of the surface treatment of TRPS plays an important role. The higher is the surface quality, the shorter is the length of space interaction, where the maximum efficiency is achieved and the higher is its value and the value of output power, which can be hundreds of watts on the second space harmonic.

articleTitle: Estimation of SAR signals compression time using different processing methods
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The investigation included computing experiments of processing of phantom, laboratory and real radioholograms using direct convolution, fast convolution and harmonic analysis. It was found that the processing time was determined not only by the number of operations, but also by the technique of program realization, and it had to be taken into account while determining the requirements to both on-board and groundbased computing systems.

articleTitle: Using two-level modulation technique QAM-FM for radio link digital updating
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of analysis results of qualitative characteristics of existing radio relay lines with frequency modulation and criteria of noise stability of communication channels with two-level modulation QAM-FM approaches to designing of the integrated shaper of high-speed data flows and television programs are formulated, power efficiency of the offered method for digital modernization of radio relay lines is estimated. Preliminary study results for a trunk throughput (total speed at level 68 Mbit/c) with use of a two-level modulation QAM-FM in the analogue radio relay line equipment of ldquoKurs-4rdquo type are presented for the broadcasting mode of 6 television programs and 16xE1digital data flows. Directions of the further researches are presented.

articleTitle: Digital TV signal transmitter for MMDS system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A transmitter of a group signal MMDS-DG/B (developed by Beta TV com Ltd.) is presented. The transmitter is intended for arrangement of digital over-the-air TV broadcasting in the range of 2,5 GHz to 2,7 GHz. Broadcasted packets with TV channels are generated according to the DVB-C standard by means of standard equipment. MMDS-DG/B has been produced, has passed certification tests and has been launched in a testing mode of broadcasting in Republic of Belarus.

articleTitle: Gallium nitride resonant tunnelling diode
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A numerical model of semiconducting resonant tunnelling diode (RTD) on a base of AlGaN/GaN/AlGaN double-barrier quantum structure (DBQS) with a GaN transit layer is created. The functional connections of diode impedance and admittance versus the frequency of a variable signal, parameters of the DBQS and the transit layer are received and investigated. For the diode with an identical width of 1 nm of DBQS layers and an optimum height of input and output AlGaN potential barriers is 0.35 and 0.44 eV. The max negative conductance is close to -7, 5 and - 3 mS at frequencies 0.35 and 0.5 THz when the width of transit layer is equal to 63 and 132 nm accordingly. The higher frequency of a band of negative conductance of diode reaches 0.9 THz under typical parameters of series parasitic resistance of contact members.

articleTitle: Space-time processing for interference rejection in antenna systems with wide radiation pattern
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A well-known space-time processing (STAP) criteria are analyzed and the interference rejection algorithms with STAP for antenna systems with wide radiation pattern are proposed.

articleTitle: Systems of information signals shaping in cavity microwave microscopy
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Ways of formation of intelligence signals in microwave microscopy are considered and analyzed with the use as measuring transmitters of cavity systems with microprobes. Circuit designs of systems of training of intelligence signals are offered and investigated, formulas describing their work are formulated, and comparative quantitative assessments of signals are made.

articleTitle: Communication systems on the basis of unmanned aircrafts (UA). Prospects and problems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Performance features, problems of analysis and synthesis of communication systems on the basis of UA are investigated.

articleTitle: Terbium photoluminescence in barium-strontium titanate fabricated in porous anodic aluminium oxide
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Barium-strontium-calcium titanate ((Ba<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.6</sub>Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.3</sub> Ca<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>)TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) is considered as a prospective material for IR-detectors. In this work we investigate photoluminescence (PL) of trivalent terbium ions in (Ba<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.6</sub>Sr<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.3</sub>Ca<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.1</sub>)TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>l, fabricated in porous anodic alumina using sol-gel method. Room-temperature PL of Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> ions with an intensive band at 543 nm is observed for Tb-doped xerogels fabricated by spinning on porous anodic alumina and annealed at 600, 750 900degC. The possibility of application of the fabricated materials for development of devices with tunable photonic band-gap is discussed.

articleTitle: Investigation of circuit diagram in metal-semiconductor contacts with schottki barrier using the method of atomic force
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: We have found out that current density distribution areally in a free contact (without a dielectric in circumferential direction) of semiconductor metal (SM) with Schottky barrier (SB) on the submicron level and the nanolevel is very incoherently. In the field of low currents with low tension the shift of the electrical circuit is determined by a narrow area (< 100 nm) in a circumferential direction of a contact. With the growth of tension in the contact we might see involvement of the rest area of the contact in the electrical circuit, in which it is determined by fractal nature of distribution of local (50 nm...200 nm) nonhomogeneities in current density. Conductivity of certain local parts in the contact area significantly differs, which leads to significant loss of efficiency of conductivity of the contact.

articleTitle: Two-port networks complex parameters measurer on the basis of traveling waves resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design method of measuring instrument of complex parameters of waveguide networks on the basis of a traveling-wave resonator (TWR) with bilateral excitation is offered. The technique of definition of parameters by the measurement results of complex reflection factors (RCF) of input and output of TWR is considered.

articleTitle: Development of MMIC element model libraries for Microwave Office design environment
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The procedure of development of electrical and topological models of libraries of new components in CAD system of Microwave Office is described. The features of construction of models are demonstrated on the examples of linear three-port network, nonlinear model of transistor, and layout cell of inductance coil for MMICs. In order to design efficiently MMICs, libraries of electrical and topological models of elements must be developed for certain MMIC technology and integrated in commercially available microwave circuit simulators such as Microwave Office (MWO) from AWR Company. The most powerful and universal approach for MWO library development is the use of Software Development Kit (SDK) and Model Wizard tools from AWR. Additionally, MS Visual Studio with C++ compiler is required. SDK allows developing of DLL libraries for the following Microwave Office parts: - linear models based on Y-parameter or netlist definition; - nonlinear models that are defined in two parts: definition of controlled current and charge sources; definition of an actual model including controlled sources and linear elements; - parameterized layout cells that use parameters of electrical models to render layout representation. A procedure for developing electrical and topological models for new components in CAD-system of Microwave Office is described. The features of development of models are demonstrated with the examples of linear three-port network, nonlinear model of transistor, and layout cell of inductance coil for MMICs.

articleTitle: Distortion components iterative injection technique for linearization of power amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents a new technique for linearization of power amplifiers based on the developed iteration algorithm for predistortion of I and Q signals. Mathematical analysis shows that such an approach allows us to obtain near perfect linear outputs of amplifiers in saturation. A polynomial behavioral model of a power amplifier is considered. The paper presents a mathematical series, which describes the components of this model. This model has been used in simulations to replace the real device. Simulation results show an improvement of 35 dB for QPSK spectrum regrowth, which is 15 dB better than the case of conventional predistortion. The accuracy of the proposed model is verified by experiment.

articleTitle: Spectra of UHF signals back scattered by water surface in the presence of soluble superficially-active substance. Experimental research
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In laboratory terms the influence of superficially-active substance (SAS) on the basic spectral parameters of cm and mm-signals on the vertical (HH) and horizontal (VV) polarizations is evaluated. Influences of insoluble and soluble SAS are compared.

articleTitle: Technical-organizational measures ensuring electromagnetic compatibility while introducing broadband wireless networks in 3400…3900 MHz frequency band
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Electromagnetic compatibility ensuring technical-organizational arrangement questions between broadband wireless networks and satellite service earth station in (3400...3900) MHz frequency band are considered.

articleTitle: Simulation of electron transport in single-wall metallic carbon nanotubes in microwave field
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Electron transport in the single-wall metallic carbon nanotubes in microwave field has been simulated by means of the direct numerical self-consistent solution of a system of the Boltzmann transport equations describing transport and scattering of electrons and phonons.

articleTitle: Solution of self consistent schrödinger and poisson equations for double photon transition in triple-barrier structures
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that for asymmetric triple-barrier resonant-tunneling structures with thin and high (delta) barriers that the solution of rheonomous self consistent equations of Schrodinger and Poisson with discovered boundary conditions along all channels of diffusion, considering resonance transitions between three quantized levels in a strong high-frequency electric field resolves itself into a system of two algebraic equations with parameters, determined by numbers of resonance levels and by proportion of small signal conductivity versus product omegaepsiv.

articleTitle: Numerical algorithms for locally-optimal processing of signals and sensitivity characteristic
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The iterative equations of parametrical minimization of functions and functionals of losses in tasks of locallyoptimal processing of signals and the equations defining quick response of solution of the task of minimization to parameters of functionals of losses and parameters of a model are obtained. The minimization techniques of functionals of losses of a general view and square functionals with limitations of type of equality with the use as observable variables of countings of a signal and its derivatives, both the fixed size, and the size varying in the process of data occurrence are defined.

articleTitle: Coherent electromagnetic fields having therapeutic influence on biological structures
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of light electromagnetic radiation on biological structures is explored. The radiation mode, which impacts the most on the process of therapeutic action, is defined.

articleTitle: Calculation of loading coefficient in direct and reverse channels. Analysis of UMTS system spectral efficiency
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The coefficient of loading in the radio channel of the system UMTS is expected. On this basis the maximal amount of subscribers, which can be simultaneously served in one channel depending on data rate, was determined. It enables attaining maximal spectral efficiency at the network construction.

articleTitle: Seamless service transfer in mm-wave band radio-access network with distributed microcellular architecture
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The simplified procedure of jointless transfer of service (handover) in a millimeter band radio-access network with the distributed microcellular architecture on the basis of a hybrid fiber-radio (HFR) is offered. The purpose of the offered handover procedure is delay decrease in an optical supply net on the basis of HFR.

articleTitle: Research of the volt-watt sensitivity of metal-semimetal BiSb contact detectors of microwave radiation, depending on contact geometry
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The expressions have been derived for the volt-watt sensitivity of thermoelectric hemispherical metal-semimetal BiSb contact detectors of microwave radiation for two cases of heat emission.

articleTitle: Antenna systems for mobile satellite applications
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the beginning of radio development, mobile communication systems were conceived for the transmission and receiving of telegraphy and telephony signals via mobile antenna at first from ships, and then from cars, trains and aircraft. The consideration of antenna transmission is inevitable, especially in Global Mobile Satellite Communications (GMSC), where their propagation characteristics are much affected by different and changeable local environments during movement of mobile and differ greatly from those observed in fixed satellite systems. To create adequate antenna hardware for mobile GMSC systems, engineers have to consider all related factors in order to realize full mechanical and transmission potentials. This article describes evolution and development of mobile antenna systems, classification and types, characteristics, requirements and basic relations of antenna systems for Maritime Mobile Satellite Communications (MMSC), Aeronautical Mobile Satellite Communications (AMSC) and Land Mobile Satellite Communications (LMSC).

articleTitle: Satellite CNS for maritime transportation augmentation system (MTAS)
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The development of the MTAS was to identify the possible applications for enhancement of digital selective call (DCS) MF/HF/VHF radio; satellite communications, navigation and surveillance (CNS); GPS and GLONASS; and safety systems including security and control of vessels, logistic and freight at sea, on inland waters and the security of crew and passengers on board ships, cruisers, boats and hovercrafts. These enhancements include many applications for the better management and operation of vessels and they are needed more than ever because of world merchant fleet expansion. Just the top 20 world ships registers have about 40,000 units under their national flags. Above all, the biggest problem today is that merchant ships and their crews are targets of the types of crime traditionally associated with the maritime industries, such as piracy, robbery and recently, a target for terrorist attacks. Thus, IMO and flag states will have a vital role in developing International Ship and Port Security (ISPS). The best way to implement ISPS is to design an Approaching and Port Control System (APCS) by special code augmentation satellite CNS including tracking and monitoring of all vehicle circulation in and out of the port area. The establishment of MTAS as a part of Global Satellite Augmentation Systems (GSAS) or GNSS-1, such as the US WAAS, European EGNOS, Japanese MSAS, Chinese SNAS, Indian GAGAN and future GSAS including African Satellite Augmentation System (ASAS) will meet all these requirements and will complement the services already provided by DGPS or Local VHF Augmentation System (LVAS) and MF radio beacons.

articleTitle: A. S. Popov and the Black Sea Fleet (to the 150-th anniversary)
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Pointed in this paper are the basic primary and secondary sources, reflecting A. S. Popov's activity on the Black Sea Fleet and in Sevastopol in 1899-1903. Presented are the fragments of the secondary sources - newspapers and letters of this period, as well as chronicles of his life and activity. Described are the facts pointing that in the beginning of practical implementation of radio communication in Russia the Black Sea Fleet was the basic testing site ant the basic subject for introducing wireless telegraph equipment.

articleTitle: LTCC and LCP technology application in design of microwave devices on the basis of metamate IALS
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Modern manufacturing techniques of microwave devices LTCC and LCP, in particular of devices on LHM, are examined. Results of modeling of microwave devices on LHM-multilayered left-handed transmission line (MLLHTL) and leaky-wave antenna (LWA) are presented. Realization of these devices is possible on the basis of technologies LTCC and LCP.

articleTitle: A well-posed mathematical model of radiometer and its experimental embodiment with noise heterodyne
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A well-posed mathematical model of a radiometer with noise and monochromatic heterodynes is proposed. It is shown that a radiometer with a noise heterodyne operates more effectively than a radiometer with monochromatic heterodyne. A prototype of a radiometer is designed and built, which allows using a noise source as well as a sinusoidal source as heterodyne. The operative embodiment of a radiometer demonstrated an increase of sensitivity by 30 dB using a noise heterodyne.

articleTitle: Diouble-channel radio-pulse short-range radar on Gunn diode
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An operation principle and a design of double-channel SRR on the basis of the radio-pulse autodyne on Gunn diode of 8-mm-range are given. The possibilities of simultaneous application both the intro-pulse and inter-pulse modes are realized in this system.

articleTitle: Surface quality influence on attenuation in slow wave structure such as slotted-ridge waveguide. Experimental research
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of an experimental research of frequency dependence of attenuation factor in a slow wave structure such as the slotted-ridge waveguide in the basic pass-band and in a stop-band are presented. Researches were conducted in a short-wave millimetric (mm) range of wave lengths. Attenuation characteristic curves of a system versus the quality of its surface depending on methods of manufacturing and ways of processing are investigated.

articleTitle: Implementation specificity for WiMAX wireless broadband access technology in the shared bands with satellite service
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Protection ratio dependences for satellite service receivers in case of join use of (3,4...3,6) MHz bands with WiMAX wireless broadband access technology (class of emission -10M0D7W) are presented.

articleTitle: Electron transport in GaAs/AlAs quantum wire transistor structure in periodical electric field
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Monte-Carlo simulation of electron transport in GaAs/AlAs quantum wire transistor structure is performed in the periodical longitudinal electric field of harmonic type. The dependencies of electron drift velocity versus time for the steady-state transport regime are calculated at 77 K.

articleTitle: Intermodulation parameters for the mixer with resonant-tunneling diode
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Comparative analysis of Schottky diode and resonant-tunneling diode (RTD) based mixers is shown. The influence of IV characteristic on intermodulation parameters of mixers is discussed. IP3 increasing facility in RTD-based mixer is experimentally shown.

articleTitle: Transceiving module for 60 GHZ bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of experimental investigations of an element base of transceiver of radar working in the 55-60 GHz bandwidth are given in the article.

articleTitle: Intelligent system for information recongnition supporting wireless standartS
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The research had shown the necessity to build smart sensor networks (ISS) of information recognition of measuring images of various purposes in the transmission of information to the consumer wireless communication channels in accordance with IEEE 1451, and IEEE 802 international standards.

articleTitle: Some questions of dosimetry in studying biological effects of EHF electromagnetic radiation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Some questions of dosimetric support of experimental studies of the mechanisms of biological effects of extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation (EHF EMR) are considered. A testing of radiators of EHF EMR was performed. Methodology of dosimetry was demonstrated by the example of investigation of energy absorption EHF EMR in the skin of laboratory animals.

articleTitle: The effect of low-intensity microwave radiation on germinating and growth intensity of wheat grains. experimental research
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: experiment of irradiation of bioobjects by the microwave exposure of low intensity was set up and held, the most interesting results of experiment are presented

articleTitle: Effective parameters of composite materials on the basis of conductive fibers of arbitrary shape
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of peculiarities of thin-wire spiral particle geometry and particle concentration on the effective electrodynamic parameters of a composite material containing such particles are analyzed using the solution of Pocklington integral equation together with Maxwell-Garnett method.

articleTitle: Multimedia data transmission system for 9,8 TO 12,2 GHz band
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A universal wireless digital system UWDS is considered (developed by Beta TV com Ltd., manufactured by OJSC LtTopazGt). It is intended for arrangement of digital over-the-air TV broadcasting in the range from 11,70 to 12,20 GHz and wireless high-speed network of data transmission in the range from 9,8 to 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Resonator for MM-band tunable filter with memory effect
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The use of features of a hysteresis loop of frequency-field curve of ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) of high-quality single-crystal sample SrFe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sub> offered for a creation of tunable microwave filter with a memory effect is proposed. Realization of the memory effect in such device consists of throwing of frequency of FMR in going of the sample from multi-domain state into the saturated state and vice versa, in the segment of nonreciprocity of dynamical curve of hysteresis.
