articleTitle: Spatially-frequency coherence of radiation field in aperture antennas
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of influence on radiation characteristics of aperture antennas of a bandwidth of a signal used for earth-based and space-based systems of radio communication is carried out. Formulas for estimation of spatially-frequency coherence of a field of radiation in conditions of atmospheric turbulence are developed.

articleTitle: Dielectric cavity antenna-active oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The development and investigation results for a transistor antenna-active oscillator based on dielectric cavity antenna are shown. The designed antenna-active oscillator has more stable oscillation frequency in comparison with an antenna-active oscillator based on printed-circuit oscillators.

articleTitle: Multi-octave devices for incident and reflected microwaves separation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The research and modeling of multi-octave devices for incident and reflected microwaves separation in coaxial lines have been carried out. Prototype samples were created and tested. Calculated and experimentally tested frequency responses and other specifications are found to be in good correspondence.

articleTitle: Frequency multiplication in ted diodes with impact ionization on InN, GaN, AlN
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Multiplication of frequency is considered at impact ionization in transfer electron InN, GaN, AIN diodes. If impact ionization takes place, coefficient of frequency transformation increases and reaches, for example, 40% for second harmonic.

articleTitle: Radar sensor for remote control of track occupancy and railway cars speed
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of development of low cost radar sensors for remote control of track occupancy and railway cars' speed over the territory of hump yards under heavy weather conditions are presented. The radar sensor feature is application of autodyne transmitting-receiving module for linear frequency modulation and digital systems for forming sounding signal and spectral processing of received signals. Sensor is equipped with the systems of remote control and transmission of radar and service information to the control point.

articleTitle: Method of slowing autoregulation for optimization of distribution phase velocity in a helix TWT
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of the suggested original method of an optimization of the law of the smooth variation of phase velocity in the output section, it is shown, that in the optimized variants of the irregular two-section helix TWT technical efficiency of 86% is reached at wave efficiency of 66%. Comparison of various distributions of an irregularity in such TWT is carried out.

articleTitle: Improved method for blind mixed noise variance evaluation on images
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The modification of blind mixed noise variance evaluation method is proposed. It is based on using weighted LMS (WLMS) algorithm for regression line fitting in the scatterplot of local variance and squared mean estimation pairs. The accuracy improvement is shown by numerical simulations for artificial and real life RS images.

articleTitle: Digital images processing in telecommunication and microwave communication systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: There was proposed a method of mapping raster contour image on the basis of coding a location of adjacent pixels in sliding measurement windows. The method is intended for automatic analyzing on transfer images as a flow of complex numbers and their recognizing in telecommunication microwave systems.

articleTitle: High frequency characteristics of mim capacitors with nanostructured anodic oxide dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: MIM capacitors have been prepared with three types of nanostructured thin film dielectrics made of anodic oxides of Al (99,99 %), AlSi (1 %) alloy and Al (99,99 %)/Ta metal bilayer. High breakdown voltages, low leakage currents and dielectric losses have been achieved. A weak dispersion of dielectric constant, from 7,3 to 6,7, and the features of temperature and frequency dependencies of dielectric losses in the range of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> to 3 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup> Hz are the signature of ion-relaxation polarization with the characteristic times ranging 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> depending on the dielectric type. The nanostructured oxide dielectrics are promising for radio frequency applications.

articleTitle: Calculation of metallic single-wall carbon nanotubes conductivity
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The dependencies of one-dimensional conductivity of such metallic single-wall carbon nanotubes as `armchair' nanotubes on the value of longitudinal electric field strength have been calculated. There was assumed that the nanotubes were placed on some substrate or into the matrix of some matter at room temperature.

articleTitle: Locally-optimal processing of digital signals
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Setting of a problem of locally-optimal processing of signals is carried out. Defining equations of signal notations on finite intervals are received, ways of description of signals on finite intervals by means of Laplace transformation and character of conversion of basic systems of functions in linear systems are defined. Functions and functionals of losses with limitations of type of equality and inequality, integral functionals and spectral responses which might be used in the performance of a task of locally-optimal processing of signals are found.

articleTitle: Multipath signals bearing in HF wave band
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of direction finding of radio signals in HF wave band is considered. This method allows finding of directions of arrival and amplitude of signals with high accuracy. It is supposed that multipath signals are received by a linear array.

articleTitle: Simulation of results of terahertz wave-bioobject interaction
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design principles of computing simulations of coupling of T-waves with bioobjects are developed. The model analysis had been fulfilled because of homodyne experiments with laser lights. Main physical assumptions and mathematical equations that were put in the base of the need computations are given.

articleTitle: Parameters of CDMA-based radio interfaces with spectrum extension. Advantages of MC DS-CDMA
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Design concepts of radio interfaces on the basis of CDMA with the spectrum broadening are considered. Characteristics of radio interfaces are presented and conclusions for application of the most effective as the basis of systems of the fourth generation are made. The appropriateness of their use is shown.

articleTitle: Radio relay link with universal precise time system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Methods and technical decisions of the use of universal precise time in systems of radio-relay stations for execution of exact scientific and navigation measurements are considered.

articleTitle: Investigation of phase transition nature in ZnS crystals
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: With the help of EPR-method the nature of phase transition 2H-3C in solid state ZnS crystals grown from the melt has been investigated.

articleTitle: EM wave diffraction on a flat slab of biisotropic material
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The boundary problem of interaction of the monochromatic electromagnetic field which is an unspecified combination of E- and the H-polarized plane electromagnetic waves with a flat slab of a biisotropic material is solved. The method of determination of effective material parameters of the biisotropic composite materials is offered.

articleTitle: The influence of interelectrode capacity on MESFET stability at the impact of pulsed EM-field
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article contains results of research of influence of bias current on Schotki FET resistibility in pulse electromagnetic fields. The basic relations used for direct calculation of bias current in FET model GaAs are given.

articleTitle: Field amplitude distribution impacting the extention of near-field reactive region in aperture radiators
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Present work is devoted to an investigation of a near-field reactive region of square aperture radiators with different field distributions in a radiated aperture. The influence of a law of amplitude distribution at the square aperture on the extent of this region along with a possibility of optimization of the radiator parameters for creation of uniform illumination in defined regions in a near zone are investigated.

articleTitle: Increasing of phase shift measuring accuracy by signal processing at high intermediate frequency
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A phase distance measurement technique is reviewed, which increases difference phase shift accuracy measurement in microwave system with a short distance between antennas.

articleTitle: Powerful pulse microwave oscillating module
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The UHF generating module with overall dimensions 46times42times36 mm permitting by the means of diodes Hannah of the type 3A750, 3A762, and avalanche transit-time diodes such as 3A765, 3A766, to implement UHF generators with target pulse capacity up to 40 Watt in the frequency range (8...96) GHz and with microprocessor management, is described.

articleTitle: Method for dual-band SPMT switches calculation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method for electrical parameters computation of the transforming circuits consisting of SPMT switches, which provide the input matching on two frequencies, is offered. The matching for the transforming devices location at the input of switch or at its outputs is considered.

articleTitle: Computer-aided measurements and rejection of high power microwave transistors on a wafer
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A computer-aided set-up and software are developed for characterization and rejecting of high power microwave transistors on a wafer. To overcome spurious oscillations and increase the accuracy of measurements a special multipin probe is fabricated. The developed software gives opportunities to realize complicated scripts of measurements and testing.

articleTitle: Using radiocommunication in order to increase efficiency of search and rescue operations at sea
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of maritime disasters and existing means of radio communication for distress vessels has been done. A number of actions to increase efficiency of search and rescue operations are considered, data are described.

articleTitle: Image reconstruction using syncronous aperture scanning
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The image reconstruction algorithm for synchronous aperture scanning is developed. The algorithm takes into account spatial separation of illuminating and receiving antennas. The increase of radial resolution is gained with the help of multifrequency probing signal. Efficiency of the algorithm is experimentally proven.

articleTitle: Electron beam forming and structure in diffraction radiation oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Characteristic features of forming of an electron beam near the surface of diffraction grating of diffraction radiation oscillator (DRO) are examined.

articleTitle: Training of its NTUU «KPI» students on satellite telecommunication systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The peculiarities and methodical ware of education of students of Engineering and Technical Service of academic curriculum of satellite telecommunication systems (STS) are stated.

articleTitle: Particles delocalization in nanostructures with complex energy profile under the action of external perturbation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: When creating the nanoelectronic devices, a number of problems arises: incorporation of discrete nanoelectronic devices and their simplest assemblies into the structure of the standard microelectronic circuits having the stable technological realization; creation of purely nanoelectronic circuits; creation of reliable electrical connections both between nano dimensional elements of the circuits and between nano and microelectronic components; temperature stability of nanoelectronic elements; bringing of newly created nanoelectronic element base parameters to the existing standards on one or another kind of devices, or creation of new standards; suppression of undesirable effects in the operation of the new element base, their origin is connected with the quantum nature of the physical processes taking place in the active zones of nanoelectronic devices etc. This work is devoted to research into quasi-continual states emerging in multilayer quantum-well structures, when the internal potential barriers are lower than the external ones, particles energetic states far above the main states in separate quantum confined regions emerge between them and are also subjected to quantum confinement.

articleTitle: Digital microwave antenna arrays design for radar purposes
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problems of designing of modern digital antenna arrays are considered. A basic module of a digital antenna array and possibilities of upgrading of existing transmit-receive modules of active implemented phased arrays are considered.

articleTitle: Microwave slot antenna on dielectric resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Investigation results of the antenna, which represents a system of coupling cylindrical dielectric resonators (DRs), situated in apertures of the wide wall of the rectangular metal waveguide, are given. Every DR has the lowest magnetic resonance H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01delta</sub>, the combined system is a whole emitting structure that forms narrow radiation pattern. It is indicated that antennas of this sort alongside with sufficiently narrow directional diagram have wider transmission bands. Main electrical parameters such as antenna radiation pattern, S-matrix coefficients, coupled and forced resonance amplitudes were calculated.

articleTitle: Anennas of 3G base station
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The directional and frequency characteristics of broadband antennas in telecommunication systems with continuous zone coverage are considered.

articleTitle: Development of etch liquid processes of complex profile silicon elements for VHF-devices
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of study and development of technological processes of liquid etching of the silicon micromechanical elements (MME) of microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) for VHF devices are submitted.

articleTitle: Feasible application of EHF dielectrometry in biological and medical investigations
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The device description elaborated for measurements of the complex permittivity of biologic objects within the free water dispersion region is presented. Measurement of permittivity of the test substances - water and ethanol/water mixtures confirm operation possibilities for biomedical investigations.

articleTitle: Investigation of 2-chlorovinyldichloroarsine decomposition products by methods of nonstationary spectroscopy of subTHz frequency range
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibilitiy of applying the developed gas spectroscopy method with phase-switching radiation in subTHz frequency range for spectral investigation of superecotoxicants and pollutants has been shown. The molecular spectra of the 2-chlorovinyldichloroarsine impurity composition and the products of 2- chlorovinyldichloroarsine decomposition have been investigated.

articleTitle: Increasing of jamming resistance for signals with Quadrature Phase-Shift Keying
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The possibility of technologic implementation of detecting action of quadrature phase shift keying of radio signals at low signal-to-noise ratio is observed in this paper.

articleTitle: Non-regularity in space topology of cellular networks with code division impacting the coverage quality
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Influence of an irregularity of a spatial topology of the cellular communication network of standard IS-95 is considered. The use of a sector site with the repetition of frequency in sectors is an optimum for communication networks with code division of channels.

articleTitle: Calculation of mass change of carbon-fiber reinforced plastic elements of antennae and MF devices in spacecrafts by producing their own disturbances
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An assessment method of impact of mass variation of added carbon - fiber reinforced plastic elements of antenna and MF devices of a spacecraft of the Earth remote sensing (ERS SC), under the influence of space factors (SF) on produced by them disturbances conditioned by their elastic properties is observed. Application conditions of the proposed method for promising SC are investigated.

articleTitle: New measuring capabilities of CK-Belan 240/280 spectrum analyzer
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article shows experimental results of comparison of phase noise performance of the best in the industry spectrum analyzers.

articleTitle: Frequency counters for millimeter and submillimeter wavelengths
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principles of operation of fast response frequency counters for millimeter and submillimeter wavelengths are developed. The frequency counter for fast frequency measurements of gyrotron and other microwave generators of continuous or pulsed emission in the frequency range (70...170) GHz is described.

articleTitle: Design of monolithic W-band SPST diode switch, mounted in E-plane of the waveguide with «dumbbell» cross-section
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design technique and results of computer designing of monolithic W-band SPST diode switch, mounted in E-plane of the waveguide with LtdumbbellGt cross-section, which differs with high adaptability to manufacture, are presented. It is found, when one uses real model of switching GaAs diode Schottky with taken into account loss and parasitic parameters, then SPST switch project at frequency band of (91...98) GHz demonstrates 2 dB insertion loss, 14 dB return loss, and 21 dB isolation.

articleTitle: Darwin Solver — a system of evolutionary analog circuit design integrated with Microwave Office
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The innovative CAD system of evolutionary analog circuit design is described. The Darwin Solver realizes structural-parametrical synthesis of corrective and matching networks, microwave filters, multistage microwave amplifiers using evolutionary algorithm. It is also shown, that integration into Microwave Office allows designing of arbitrary circuit connected with evolutionary synthesized two-port sub-circuits. The proposed hybrid genetic algorithm is based on special mechanism, which decreases the topological convergence. We use both binary-coded and real-coded representations. The experiments showed that Darwin Solver was capable to find nearer-optimal solutions after 5...50 thousand circuit simulations, that was equal to few minutes on typical PC.

articleTitle: Simulation of phase noise influence on oscillators synchronization system operation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The simulation results of a work of a phase-locked loop system are presented. The main aim of this simulation is determination of influence of phase noise in a channel on stability of initial stage of low frequency oscillations in the receiver point. The results of experimental investigations of influence of phase noise in a communication channel on operation of a system of phase locking are presented at the report.

articleTitle: Possibility of broadening continuous electrical frequency tuning in mm-wavelength clinotron: Experimental investigation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper, possibilities of the extension of the continuous frequency tuning bandwidth in the clinotron operating frequency range are studied. The most attractive approach is optimization of the geometry of the slow-wave oscillatory system of the tube. It is shown that by means of the distance variation between the slow-wave structure and the opposite cavity wall it is possible to provide the continuous frequency tuning bandwidth up to (20...25)%.

articleTitle: Object classification method based on scattered field correlation analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A novel radioholographic classification method based on correlation between scattered fields of the registered and the model objects is proposed and approved.

articleTitle: Broadband microwave signal transformation in stroboscopic systems under coherent probing
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: High distance resolution in the close-range location systems with the use of microwave signals of nanosecond latency is pursued. It is shown that a consumption of coherent stroboscopic processing of reflected signals allows combining of high distance resolution with the possibility of a velocity selection for the low-velocity objects.

articleTitle: RASTR — wireless system for digital TV broadcasting within 6.17…6.425 GHz
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The RASTR system is considered. It has been designed by LtBeta TV comGt ltd. for the broadcast transmission of digital television over the-air using DVB-C standard in the range of (6,17...6,425) GHz. The system started operating in a testing mode of broadcasting in Kaliningrad region. Block diagrams of basic parts of the system and technical decisions used in the design of RASTR system are described in this article.

articleTitle: Single-frequency TV network. Broadcasting using “Beta TV com” equipment
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The whole system of digital equipment which allows arranging of a single-frequency (DVB-T) network on the equipment of one manufacturer is considered.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation of dipole-exchange spin excitations in nickel nanowires
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Numerical investigation of static and dynamic properties of Ni cylinder nanowire of finite height was conducted. Frequencies of two lowest even and odd dipole-exchange spin modes as a function of applied bias magnetic field were plotted.

articleTitle: Pulse power sources for subrelativistic magnetron
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of experimental study and simulation of impulse power sources in the voltage range of (100...300) kV for feeding the mm-wavelength magnetron are discussed.

articleTitle: Errors of target detecting using triangulation method in radar with phased antenna array
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper a study of spatial beam pattern of electrically scanning antenna arrays in order to obtain the curve of a bearing error versus the height of bearing targets in the azimuthal plane in the cases of different ranges.

articleTitle: Solid state transceiver modules for advanced millimeter-wave radar technology
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Technological and scientific potential of Research Institute "Orion" is presented in the field of development of high performance active and passive solid-state microwave devices, modules and components as well as multifunctional devices on their basis. All these products taken together form solid-state component base for advanced systems and equipment in frequency range up to 200 GHz.

articleTitle: Radiating losses influence on characteristics of microwave resonator measuring converters with coaxial aperture
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of calculations on numerical model of the microwave converter with the coaxial measuring aperture are discussed. Conditions at which it is necessary to consider radiating losses are found.

articleTitle: Laser diffraction diagnostics of liquid biological environments (fraungoffer's light diffraction on the particle of blood)
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The laser diagnostic technique of parameters of blood's particles is offered. The technique is based on registration and mathematical processing data on laser diffraction from specially obtained smears of blood. Mathematical processing is based on treatments of the theory of diffraction of light on disorder environments. Data of optical measurements are in good agreement with direct measurements of the sizes of blood particles.

articleTitle: Analysis of wireless network efficiency
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The way of analysis of broadband wireless network construction is submitted.

articleTitle: Superconducting quantum electronics based on stochastic resonance systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principles are developed for amplification of weak informational signals in superconductive quantum interferometers (SQUIDs) based on the effect of stochastic resonance (SR) at arbitrary low temperature and in arrays of SR-SQUIDs. Numerically calculated gain is 30 dB under signal-to-noise ratio approaching to (10...20) dB. New RF field-controlled SR-antennas for SQUIDs are suggested.

articleTitle: Surface magnetostatic waves in bounded one-dimensional ferrite structures
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the report results of theoretical research of characteristics of propagation of surface magnetostatic waves in periodic and quasi-periodic one-dimensional magnon crystals are presented.

articleTitle: Instrumentation for nonlinear distortion measurements under wideband pulse probing
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Original measuring technique of a nonlinear distortion is realized in the network analyzer R4-I-01. Efficiency of these methods in time and frequency domains is shown.

articleTitle: Waveguide T-branching with matching resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The electrodynamic problem concerning excitation by a waveguide wave of the T-branching with a matching dielectric-filled resonator of the beyond-cutoff or through-pass type is solved. Peak-frequency characteristics of the system are calculated for various ratios between length of a wave, the sizes of wave guides, resonators and parameters of environment. Areas of values of parameters of the full coordination of wave guides are defined.

articleTitle: Applied software for electromagnetic simulation of planar microwave device performances
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Possibilities of application of the program EM-Finity for electromagnetic analysis of microstrip planar microwave devices with the use of vectorial finite element method. Comparison of simulations and measurements show a good coincidence with the testing structure.

articleTitle: MICROWAVE signal parametric transfer via radio channel using running wave resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Traveling-wave resonators (TWR) designed on the basis of directional couplers (DC), with locked up in the ring secondary arms, find a wide application in the systems of combining and decommutation of frequency channels, for example in the circuits of directed filters. A technical decision directed on a formation of a modulated signal with one adjacent frequency, for the application in various radio engineering systems of microwave is offered.

articleTitle: Class-F power amplifier design for 5,8 GHz frequency band using metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A class-F power amplifier at 5.8 GHz using a novel harmonic tuner based on a composite right/left handed (CRLH) transmission line (TL) is proposed and experimentally tested. The structure uses two open CRLH-TL stubs to suppress the 2nd, the 3rd, the 4th and the 5th harmonics and the fundamental frequency is matched to 50 Omega.

articleTitle: Investigation of wine and wort permittivity in the microwave range
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Measurements of the permittivity (epsiv') of table wines and juices for their production (worts) are performed in the microwave range. The microwave permittivity of wort determines epsiv' of wine (made from this wort) as well as the quantity of sugar and alcohol in it.

articleTitle: Phase noise decreasing in CK4-Belan 32 spectrum analyzer
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A comparative analysis of phase noise characteristics for various high-end spectrum analyzers is presented.

articleTitle: Potential accuracy of matrix pencil method for 2-d signals
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method of matrix pencil under the approximation of two-dimensional narrow-band signals is proposed. Estimation of the potential immunity of the method for the signal containing two complex-conjugated two-dimensional exponents is presented. A statistical modeling shows that the estimation error of expansion parameters of two-dimensional signal is situated above the bound of Cramer-Rao on 10 dB, which is indicative of the efficiency of the offered modification of the method of matrix pencil.

articleTitle: Orotrons with double-row periodic structure and spherocylindrical and multifocal mirrors
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An experimental investigation of two modifications of orotron in (120...220) GHz frequency range is carried out. The electrodynamic system is formed by an open resonator consisted of one plane mirror on which the double-row periodic structure (DRPS) is settled down and other focusing mirror having the shape of a spherocylinder in one case or multifocal spherical mirror in the other. The longitudinal axis of spherocylinder is parallel to the axis of symmetry of DRPS. The multifocal mirror is formed by some (3 or 4) crossed spherical surfaces with the general plane of symmetry along the interaction space of the device. The comparison of output parameters of orotrons with multifocal and spherocylindrical mirrors shows that the correct choice of its geometry allows receiving the efficient increase of the interaction length and corresponding reduction of a start current value in the orotron.

articleTitle: Game-theoretical synthesis of antijamming system of nonlinear radiolocation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of a research of immunity of systems of nonlinear radar with the application of mathematical apparatus of games theory are presented. The optimal game algorithms of a behavior of nonlinear radiolocation under the interference attack with different characteristics are found.

articleTitle: Long-term consequences of bioinformatics effects of EMP EHF on mammals reproduction
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The paper examined the impact of EMI EHF on the vital functions of the organism of mammals on the example of Wistar rats. The frequency of radiation - 37 GHz, the treatment effects - bioinformatics; radiation power - (0,5...1,5) mW.

articleTitle: Microwave system of multiservice wireless access
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A system, which allows supplying of subscribers with multiservice radio access to information resources by the channels of models of Gaussa, Raysa, Releya in a radius to 70 km, is described. Number of subscribers is more 100000.

articleTitle: Central teleport as a component of terrestrial infrastructure of national satellite communication system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of the conducted marketing probing and modern lines of development of satellite systems, systems of distribution of the audiovisual information have a high level of yield. Basic profits from operator activity bring services of the direct broadcasting of TV-, radio-programs.

articleTitle: Parametric instability in oscillator with delayed load reflection
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The stability of stationary modes is studied with relation to perturbation actions of two types: 1) the principal mode, characterizing by slow amplitude and frequency variations of balance condition, 2) RF fields which frequencies have relatively large deviations from that of the principal mode. In the latter case perturbations are composed of satellites pumped by the principal mode; correspondingly the evolution of satellites represents a parametric process.

articleTitle: Digital beamforming multibeam antenna array design
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This report proposes research results under designing of modular 12-element Digital Antenna Array (or Smart Antenna). This paper presents results under researching influence of ADC (analog-to-digital converter) parameters to characteristics of a whole system, performs modeling for the purpose to find out influence of a gain-phase scattering to an antenna beam pattern.

articleTitle: Scientometric analyis of articles submitted to International Crimean Conference «Microwave and Telecommunication Technology» in global electronic databases
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The scientometric analyzes of articles submitted to International Crimean Conference ldquoMicrowave and Telecommunication Technologyrdquo was made both for printed articles and Scopus electron abstracts database.

articleTitle: Multiple access and broadcasting in self-organizing radio networks with Ultra Wide Band pulse signals
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Pulse ultra wide band signals are proposed to use in ad hoc and MANET radio networks to solve problems of media access control and signal relay.

articleTitle: Negative temperature coefficient of breakdown voltage in the Au-Ti-n-n+ 6h SiC Schottky-barrier diodes
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Temperature coefficient of breakdown voltage (TCBV) in the Au-Ti-n-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-6H SiC diodes with Schottky barrier is investigated. It is shown that TCBV is negative in the (300...573) K temperature range. This seems to be caused by the effect of deep levels in the space-charge region of a diode on the breakdown.

articleTitle: Leader discharge as an initiator of long-living plasma formation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of experimental research of the excitation conditions of formation of long-living plasma in the weak electrolytes under the influence of electric discharge are presented. Description of experimental model, photos of the leader discharge at initial stage of plasma excitation, the discussion of obtained results are presented.

articleTitle: Passive components equivalent network in microwave CAD
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Models of the equivalent schemes of chip-inductors and capacitors at microwave range were designed and studied. These models are suitable to use in modern CAD. There are measured and calculated nominal values of elements in these schemes. The dependence of these parameters vs. nominal value of chip-element and frequencies is determined. Inaccuracy of modeling in case of using these models is evaluated.

articleTitle: Faulty element determination in microwave path of radio system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The methodic of estimation of position of faulty element of antenna-waveguide systems, which allows increasing the operation efficiency of the radioelectronic systems, is considered.

articleTitle: Optimized calibration system of total power spectroradiometer for ozone line observation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The antenna chopper and data processing system of microwave spectroradiometer for atmospheric ozone monitoring at the frequency 110836 MHz are considered. It is realized fully digital real time postdetection signal processing at the sampling frequency up to 25 kHz for each of 32 spectroradiometer channels.

articleTitle: Composite base element in the system of mathematical modelling and designing of microwave devices and phased arrays — “LambdaMDS”
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design principles of composite base element for computation of given power branching in waveguides are developed. The new base element is added into integrated program complex ldquoLambdaMDSrdquo. It is shown, that computed data are in the good agreement with results of measuring, and design of input data is more simple.

articleTitle: Nanostructured porous silicon formation for combustion and explosion processes
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of porous silicon structures on processes of combustion and explosion have been investigated. The combustion procedure has been observed in the porous silicon layers, formed by anode process, if the specific area has been more 100 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. It has been also found that the intensity of combustion had increased with broadening of specific area of porous silicon and if the latter had been larger 200 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> the explosion process had occurred. The time response of development of explosion has been in the microsecond range.

articleTitle: New designs of microwave BSF structure
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: New designs of microwave band-stop filters with a wide stop band for transmitter-receiver system are presented. Optimal parameters of transmission lines for equal-ripple characteristics |S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sub>| in a stop band and a pass band are determined.

articleTitle: Correlation of complex permittivity and physico-chemical parameters of table wines
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Resonance and waveguide methods of measurement of complex permittivity of high absorbing liquid at millimeter wave length are proposed and implemented. The methods are based on the use of electromagnetic wave crossing through a dielectric rod surrounded by an investigated liquid. Coefficients of pair correlation of complex permittivity of wine with its physicochemical parameter were obtained.

articleTitle: Influence of microwave processing on sowing features of seeds of the common spruce
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of basic researches on revealing of modes of the microwave irradiation improving sowing properties of seeds of European fur-trees are presented.

articleTitle: Determination of pulse signal radiation sources with known coordinates in the radio ether
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The way for determination of presence of sources of radiation of pulse signals (SRPS) with known co-ordinates in the air by means of a three-position small-base passive system for measurements of differences of times of a signal arrival (TDOA method) is developed. On the basis of simple ratios between co-ordinates of system reception centers and the purpose, following from geometry of their mutual disposition, analytical expressions for highly informative (with the big relation parameter/interference) determinations of a difference of differences of times of a signal arrival and the adaptive criterion fixing with certain accuracy a true value of inclined range to the purpose, are received. Mathematical modeling is carried out at various trajectories of a target movement and laws of distribution of errors of measurement of differences of times of a signal arrival.

articleTitle: Certain cause of hidden deterioration of magnetron efficiency
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A technique for parameter checking of oscillatory system of a magnetron is proposed, enabling to determine the cause of appearing of internal defects in the production of oscillators. It is shown that the ways of indirect estimation of "destruction" of spectrum of spatial harmonics of a HF field of a slow-wave structure of anode of magnetron make it possible to minimize the risk of appearing of internal defects, which result from the defects of its oscillatory system.

articleTitle: Influence of interface fractal geometry on anamalous behaviour of capacity-voltage characteristic of metal-semiconductor contacts with Shottky barrier
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: With the use of a term of fractal surfaces there was proved that irregularities of a potential (barrier) and an electric charge in real metal-semiconductor interfaces with Schottky barrier had a fractal geometry, which in a local approximation influenced greatly on a behavior of capacity-voltage characteristics of metal-semiconductor contacts with Schottky barrier exerting in an anomalous increase of capacity of contacts while their diameters in a decreasing less than the limit of the local approximation.

articleTitle: Terahertz band FEL with advanced bragg reflectors
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Possibility of realization of terahertz planar FEL is demonstrated based on advanced Bragg reflectors exploiting the coupling between propagating and quasi cut-off modes. Such structure allows providing spatial coherence radiation on two coordinates for large oversize of interaction space.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of generalized synchronization in microwave range
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new approach devoted to detect the generalized synchronization in the microwave range has been developed. The efficiency of this method is illustrated with the help of investigation of behavior of two coupled klystron oscillators.

articleTitle: Circular groove-type antenna with rotary polarization
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Circular microstrip antenna having non-symmetrical excitation by means of coaxial feeder and reactive stub might perform rotary polarized radiation. Suggested groove-type antenna operates in the analogous manner: coaxial waveguide TE11 mode excites circumferential slot. The straight or two-layer waveguide options might be used: the second one is more prospective for development of multiple band antennas.

articleTitle: 27–31 GHz MMIC low noise amplifier with filtering functions for space communication system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design of Ka-band MMIC filtering LNA for spatial system based on 0,1 mum GaAs mHEMT D01MH technology (OMMIC) is presented. The design of 3-stage Ka-band MMIC LNA for space communications is described. The use of matching networks (MNs) with filtering functions in LNA leads to improving of performances of spatial systems such as stability, noise, and receiver and transmitter channel insulation, simplifying filters, and reducing bulk and weight. MNs are designed with GENESYN, a CAD tool for automatic synthesis of networks based on genetic algorithm. MMIC LNA is implemented with 0,1 mum mHEMT GaAs D01MH technology (OMMIC, France). Within (27...31) GHz band it provides the 21 dB gain and 1.7 dB noise figure.

articleTitle: Measurement of dielectric films' microwave parameters
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method for studying of the microwave parameters of dielectric films, deposited on high-Q substrate without a metal layer, was developed. The essence of the method is the excitation of a hyperfine dielectric resonator (DR) as a two-layer structure: substrate-film.

articleTitle: Modeling of aeroions sensor field
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Computation and design of the field in the sensor for the calculation of quantity of negative aeroions are made.

articleTitle: Design of table-based nonlinear model for pHEMT
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A procedure for constructing of table-based nonlinear model of pHEMT is described and investigated. Standard nonlinear models of transistors presenting in commercially available simulators (such as Curtice-Ettenberg, Materka-Kacparzak, Angelov models, etc.) have several disadvantages while applying to pHEMTs. A procedure for constructing of universal table-based nonlinear model of pHEMT is described using measured C-V characteristics and small signal S-parameters for different biases. The accuracy of table-based model up to 60 GHz has been investigated for 0,18 um GaAs pHEMT with 6 times 50 um gate width. The model is incorporated in Microwave Office design environment.

articleTitle: Diagnostics and forecasting of SCR protons flux using radio bursts parameters
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The purpose of the given work is the further increase of accuracy of diagnostic and forecast of a flux of protons of solar cosmic rays (SCR) and coronal mass ejection (CME) on the Earth's orbit by parameters of solar radio bursts registered by RT-22 radio telescope of the CrAO scientific research institute.

articleTitle: Substrate design enabling to increase HEMTs open channel breakdown voltage
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Avalanche-injection inconsistence in a substrate of a device is responsible for the open channel breakdown in FETs. Proposed substrate construction suppresses the advancing of inconsistence in HEMTs.

articleTitle: Experimental estimation for interference action of fixed service transmitting equipment on receiving equipment of terrestrial mobile service at frequency band sharing
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of interference impact experimental estimation of low capacity digital radio relay station (DRRS) to land mobile service VHF and UHF radio receiver are considered.

articleTitle: Intellectual routing in mobile Ad-Hoc networks
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new routing method for the mobile ad-hoc networks is presented, consisting of dynamic selection of control efficiency function, routing mode, route quantity and probing method for the route construction and the route maintenance.

articleTitle: Nanotechnology of Mn4Si7 epitaxial film formation on monocryctalline silicon
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This research is devoted to the study of the formation regularities of the Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub> epitaxial films mediated surfactant Sb in the Mn(25 nm)/Sb(0,2...1 ML)/buffer Si(100 nm)/Si(001) nanodimensional film composition (NFC).

articleTitle: Localized states of nanodimensional semiconductor structures
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The approach to the description of nanodimensional semiconductor structures based on definition of own energy that picked up from the Schroumldinger's equation which to enable to formalize the disordered atomic matrix is presented. Parameters of the aperiodic lattice, providing the quantitative and qualitative specification of a defect of crystal structures, are presented. The comparison of a modeling own energy spectrum with the energy distribution for centers of experimental samples gives possibility to describe a nuclear matrix internal structure for working layers of nano-devices.

articleTitle: 3 mm low-noise amplifier and radiometric module on its basis
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On basis of MMIC's the low-noise amplifier (LNA) have been developed in frequency band (82...89) GHz. The LNA provides gain 28 dB and has NF about 6.5 dB. On base of this amplifier was designed radiometric module with sensitivity 25 mK/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> in total power mode.

articleTitle: The model of datastream management in the networks with pseudowire edge-to-edge services (PWE3)
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The model of optimization of the use of network resource in PWE3 on the segment - commutation centre-controller of base station, which takes into account the behavior of selfsimilar traffic when queues are organized is offered.

articleTitle: Comparing computed and experimental characteristics of waveguide-dielectric resonator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The computed dependences of the eigen frequencies f and Q-factors Q for the H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">111</sub> mode of the waveguide-coaxial resonator (WCR) as a function of resonator parameters have been obtained. The comparison of the computed and experimental data is an evidence of close fit.

articleTitle: Homodyne microwave gauge for measurement of multicomponent mixture humidity
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Known microwave methods of measurement of humidity of materials were analyzed. The block diagram of homodyne meter of humidity of a multicomponent mixture was developed. Possible areas of its application were specified.

articleTitle: Kimberlite fracture by prompt microwave-heating
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present paper concerns the study of kimberlite fracture processes by prompt microwave heating. The processes leading to kimberlite fracture are considered, and mechanisms of its fracture are defined. Results of research of kimberlite dielectric characteristics are presented. Results of researches of processes of the fracture carried out by resonator-type installation unit with capacity of SHF power supply of 600 W and 5 kW are represented. Power estimations of processes of kimberlite crushing by SHF energy, showing new method availability, are carried out.

articleTitle: Research of cold start processes in magnetron with cold secondary-emission cathode
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Theoretical analysis of auto-oscillations' excitation mechanism in magnetrons with cold secondary-emission cathode is carried out. Auto-oscillations' excitation by external modulation of anode voltage is studied. Conditions of specified mechanism implementation are defined. Comparison of numerical modeling results and experimental data, obtained for millimeter wavelength band magnetrons, is presented.

articleTitle: Simulation of noise factor in gan field transistors using Monte Carlo technique
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The definition technique for noise parameters of field transistors is created and the block diagram for definition of noise characteristics by a method of Monte-Carlo is presented. Calculations of noise parameters for structures of AIII-BV type are resulted at various pressures at a gate and a drain. During calculation the minimum value of factor of noise for GaN NF ap1.159 dB has been received.

articleTitle: Influence of electron temperature velocity distribution on chaotic dynamics of electron beam with virtual cathode
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Influence of electron temperature velocity initial distribution upon virtual cathode (VC) nonlinear dynamics and output characteristics of devices with a virtual cathode are analyzed by means of 2D numerical simulation. It was discovered that electron velocity distribution in the electron beam cause VC oscillations to break off.

articleTitle: Self-oscillations in the active electrical vibrator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Model of self-oscillator with resonator in form of thin electric vibrator stimulated by active non-linear current of dipole is suggested in the article. The model is based on representation of motion equation in form of nonlinear integral Volterra equation and its numerical solutions.

articleTitle: Numerical researches of radiating and matching properties of microstrip multielement phased array with adequate simulation of coaxial feed lines
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Full-wave solution of electromagnetic problem about lumped excitation microstrip phased array has been obtained. Novelty of the offered mathematical model is in the adequate description of a coaxial feeder influence on characteristics of the microstrip phased antenna array. It is reached by full-wave modeling, as a microstrip radiator of the phased antenna array, as that part of a coaxial feeder which directly adjoins to antenna element of an array.

articleTitle: 1 KW power amplifier for 30…180 MHz bandwidth
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A power amplifier (hereinafter referred as PA) for a transmitter of the bandwidth (30...180) MHz with output power of 1 kilowatt is designed. The amplifier is able to operate into load with KWR of 2,5. A power division bridge and a power addition bridge, a directional coupler, harmonic filter and 1 kilowatt artificial load-attenuator with VSWR les 1.2 were developed for the transmitter.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of switching frequency allocation in measuring channel of switched radiometer
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The peculiarities of pressure allocation of switching frequency and the main parameters of the selective filter influence on characteristics of switched radiometer have been considered here.

articleTitle: Variable-temperature microwave cryogenic noise source
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A compact variable-temperature microwave cryogenic noise source was designed and tested. It works at (26, 5...40) GHz and (75...110) GHz frequency range (two outputs) with VSWR as low as 1, 1. Output temperature may be set at (100...300) K range with 1 K error. The noise source may work during 5 hours without refilling liquid nitrogen. A metal Dewar of the source has 3-liter capacity. A high performance of the noise source is due to oversized circular waveguides used between cooled absorbers and output waveguides.

articleTitle: Local radio sources near polar region of the Sun observed during the eclipse on August 1, 2008
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: During observation of solar eclipse on the August 1, 2003 on radio telescopes RT-22 and RT-3 of the CrAO at wavelengths of 2,0; 2,8; 3,5; 10,5 and 12,5 cm the compact radio sources in subauroral area of the Sun which were conterminous by a position with bright EUR-patterns 195 A on the data SOHO were detected.

articleTitle: Excitation equations for the arbitrarily-irregular coaxial waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The exact excitation equations for the arbitrarily-irregular coaxial waveguide by electron beams on base of a coordinate transformation method and a projection method are formulated.

articleTitle: Increasing of data complexing efficiency in multispectral location system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: An investigation of influence of thermal infrared (IR) band on the result of multilevel data fusion in passive multichannel satellite system Landsat 7 ETM+ was carried out.

articleTitle: Moving image segmentation using interframe weighting processing
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: New approach of image marking of moving objects with application of relative n-tuple differential contour maps, stable to spatial altitude and scale, is shown.

articleTitle: Priority service at competitive radio channel access
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A protocol which provides priority in outstanding packets retransmissions for certain subscribers under competitive access is proposed and investigated.

articleTitle: Piezoresistance effect in carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the work the research of the piezoresistance effect in the carbon nanotubes is carried out. The change of band structure of conductor and semi-conductor nanotubes, caused by its compression and expansion, is analyzed.

articleTitle: Forming of germanium nanoclusters in the films of germanosilicate glass
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of study of forming of nanoclusters of germanium in the films of Ge-silicate glass (GSG) (Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Ge<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</sub>), obtained in the process of oxidization and heat treatment of polycrystalline silicon films alloyed by germanium with the use of atomic power microscopy (APM), are presented.

articleTitle: Software for the platform of communication services providing. Engineering approach
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Apparatus for testing and analysis of software of platforms of rendering of services by providers is suggested. It is based on the use of diagrams of forms and functions (FFD). The algorithm of representing of FFD in view of finite-state machine (FSM) is described. Methods of analysis of FFD realized on the base of theory of graphs are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of U-shaped slot resonators in microstrip line ground plane
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The computation algorithm of the scattering matrix of the U-shaped slot resonator in the ground plane of a microstrip line by the transverse resonance was developed. Analysis of this discontinuity is based on the expansion of the electromagnetic field in a slot resonator in the ground plane in terms of odd TE- and TH-modes of a U-waveguide. The spectral characteristic of the unit cell and scattering signature for finite number of units of the microstrip-slotline structure in the frequency band (2...6) GHz are presented.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of microwave radiation impacting water-oil emulsions
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of an experimental study of the effect of microwave radiation on water-oil emulsions with different volumetric water content are shown. It was determined that for the studied samples, there were expressed frequency bands, where absorption of microwave radiation had the maximum. It is the range of frequencies where the resonant interaction of microwave radiation with the complex microstructure of oil might be expected.

articleTitle: Power pulsed Terahertz range gyrotrons
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The frequency of radiation higher than 1 THz has been recently demonstrated in pulse gyrotrons. The output power P = 1,6 kW at 1 THz and 0.5 kW at 1,3 THz has been obtained at the fundamental harmonic. Gyrotrons demonstrate single-mode operation with a frequency of 1 THz in the long pulse (1 ms) operation regime at the 2nd cyclotron harmonic (P~100 W) and at the 3rd harmonic (P = 0,4 kW).

articleTitle: Fractal geometry of reliefs and surface potentials in epitaxial gallium arsenide and barrier metallization
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: It is shown that relief forms of surface and character of distribution of potential irregularities of epitaxial gallium arsenide and barrier Au-metallization have fractal geometry, which in a local approximation must be defined as geometry and homogeneity of metal -semiconductor contact interfaces with Shottky barrier. This must be considered while designing the submicron and nano metal-semiconductor contacts.

articleTitle: Initiation and suppression of chaotic generation in the chain of gyro-backward wave tube
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The present report deals with the origin and the suppression of chaotic generation modes in the unidirectional connected gyro-backward wave tube (GBWT). It was shown that it is possible to establish both the modes of chaotic generation and the modes of stationary oscillations in the chain of GBWT when the frequency and the power of first GBWT change. The physical processes, resulted in the origin of synchronization and chaotic generation in the active medium, are studied too.

articleTitle: Antennas on the basis of the irregular structures with different fractal dimension
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of formation of reproduced irregular fractal radiating structures with the set dimension is developed. Experimental results of research of input characteristics of some models of such aerials are presented.

articleTitle: Research of external noise effecting upon oscillations of klystron active oscillator
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of experimental investigation of influence of external noise on oscillations of klystron active oscillator are given.

articleTitle: Near fields of combined waveguide-slot radiators in matter
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem about the electromagnetic waves radiation into the homogeneous isotropic medium with losses by the system of combined slot radiators in the broad wall of a rectangular waveguide has been solved in the strict self-consistent formulation. The spatial distribution of the near field intensity in the matter with the electrophysical parameters, corresponding to some tissues of man, has been investigated.

articleTitle: UHF dual class E power amplifier with capacitor in series to switch
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The dual class E amplifier with series to switch capacitor is presented. The values of amplifier of elements of load network are determined. A method of output transmission-lines of design of an amplifier is also presented. The method is proved to satisfy experience with good accuracy.

articleTitle: Trace contaminant detection in aqueous solutions using the method of capillary-waveguide resonance
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of capillary-waveguide resonance for an investigation of aqueous solutions for detection of the trace content in the wave band (54...78) GHz is used. An influence of a degree of water purification on frequency, Q-factor and absorption depth of energy under resonance is investigated.

articleTitle: Dangerous meteorological phenomena detection by receiving the signals from global positionig navigation sattelites
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method of detection of dangerous meteorological phenomena using the data of coordinate measurement by receivers of systems of global satellite navigation GLN and GPS is presented. A possibility of detection of thunderstorm centers and strong clouds by data of pseudo-distances and altitudes is theoretically and experimentally confirmed.

articleTitle: Calculation of the device compensating reflection of H01-waves of round wave guide from dielectric window
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method of compensating of reflection of the symmetrical H-wave from the dielectric window by means of a bulge or groove, combined with the dielectric window, and organizing resonance system of type of the half-wave resonator is offered. Calculations for choice heights and steepness of a bulge and the groove, ensuring the underload reflection of a wave for the dielectric diaphragm of different thickness and inductivity given values are carried out.

articleTitle: Bistatic radar system using radio signals of geostationary satellites for hydrometeors parameters determination
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Bistatic systems offer an opportunity to install a transmitter, where they have no influence on a human being and environment and allow receiving signals in some advantageous positions. In this paper geostationary signals are proposed as probing ones. Primary purposes of the system are to determine hydrometeors parameters and to diagnose hazardous occurrences, such us: showers, hail formations, lightings, turbulences, etc.

articleTitle: Features of tunneling in IP/MPLS transport networks
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: By means of tunneling packages of data are transferred through a shared network, as by usual point-to-point connection. It is known, that under certain conditions creation in virtual channel MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) tunnels essentially increases efficiency of data transmission, for example in mobile communication system. However there are conditions at which application of tunneling is undesirable. In the given work the practical technique of an estimation of efficiency of tunneling is developed, and characteristic curve of the maximum number of nodes versus loading on routers for a case of obtaining of a positive effect from MPLS tunneling is defined.

articleTitle: Quantum nanosensor for cosmic microparticles control
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Sensor nanostructures of the type metal-insulator-metal (MIM) based on super thin dielectric films sensitive to a microshock have been simulated. Parameters of a ballistic quantum MIM nanosensor have been determined for the control of high speed meteoroidal and caused by technological activities of people microparticles in conditions of space environment.

articleTitle: Business processes development in distributed systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The article is intended for description of a modified approach of development process of distributed systems driven by a model and language which is used in this approach.

articleTitle: Resonant iris with the slot arbitrary oriented in rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The problem of electromagnetic wave scattering by a resonant iris of finite thickness with the slot arbitrary oriented in the rectangular waveguide cross-sectional plane is solved. The influence of geometric parameters of the iris on its electrodynamic characteristics within the rectangular waveguide fundamental wave band is investigated.

articleTitle: Tunable microwave filters with uncoupled dielectric resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The tunable filters based on uncoupled dielectric resonators are presented. The main idea is to provide a minimal coupling between dielectric resonators.

articleTitle: Intelligent system for analyzing information patterns of gaseous, liquid and heterogeneous matters
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The purpose of this work is to describe the development of the biosensor intelligent system with software on basis of micro-nanolaboratory on the type chip electronic tongue (e-tongue), electronic nose (e-nose) and optical micro-tomography for rapid analysis of gaseous, liquid and heterogeneous matters, which can be applied in medicine, ecology, industrial biotechnology, food industry, agriculture, military defence and national safety.

articleTitle: Control action of MM-waves on space stations indemnification
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The opportunities of indemnification of negative influence of factors of space on a fitosystem in conditions of orbital stations are considered. Influences of the microgravitation, the gas environment and the water mode are carried out due to the influence of fields of various natures, and first of all of E-field radiation of MM range of lengths of waves on all stages of a physiological evolution of plants. Microgravitation of space stations influences on fitosystems (vegetative systems) and breaks the physiology of their development. Development of plants depends on the influence of electrostatic and electromagnetic fields. The resulted laws show, that microgravitation might be compiled by the influence of E-field radiation in the MM-range of lengths of waves.

articleTitle: Gyroklinotron efficiency optimization at the first and the third harmonics of cyclotron frequency
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of optimization of gyroklinotron parameters by efficiency at f=100 GHz with interaction on the first and the third harmonics of the cyclotron frequency are presented. The predicted electron efficiency of gyroklinotron reaches 70% on first harmonic and 40% on third harmonic, i. e. more than in usual gyrotron. Besides in contrast to common gyrotron the width of electron beam on radius of guiding centre of electron orbits in gyroklinotron might considerably exceed bearing length of the wave lambda. This allows using more powerful electron beams than in the typicall gyrotron.

articleTitle: Nonlinear analytical theory of planar free-electron maser with axial magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The action-angle variables for the test electron in the pump magnetic field of a planar FEM with an axial magnetic field are built by means of the superconvergent procedure. Using these variables and the method of the nonlinear resonance, the quasione-dimensional (the dimensions of the equations of motion is one and a half) model of the studied FEM under the undulator resonance is derived. The self-consistent model of the planar FEM with the axial magnetic field coincides with the basic TWT model and provides quiet full analytical description.

articleTitle: Investigation of ultra broadband chaotic signals generated by microwave oscillator based on virtual cathode with electronic feedback
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of an experimental study of microwave chaos generator based on a virtual cathode with an electronic feedback are presented.
