It was experimentally determined that microwave generator of noise-like oscillations in the electronic feedback had had an ultra-band generation. The statistical properties of generated signals are shown. The promising areas of application of considered ultrabroadband microwave sources are introduced.

articleTitle: Schematic methods of enhancing radiation hardness of CMOS LSI
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analysis is conducted regarding the methods of enhancing CMOS LSI radiation hardness. The examples of CMOS LSI show, that the schematic methods are the most prospective from the point of view of ensuring reliability and radiation hardness.

articleTitle: Cold plasma based loop antenna
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of researches of input descriptions of loop antenna on the basis of cold plasma gas discharge are presented. Advantages of such antennas are mentioned.

articleTitle: Linearization of power amplifier with balancing cascades
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In the report variants of linearization of the power amplifier on balancing cascades (BK) are presented. Results of modeling and experimental researches of model samples are introduced. Reduction of IMI distortions of signals QAM 64,128,256 with width of signal spectrum 28 MHz on (5...6) dB in the variation range of input powers (4...6) dB is experimentally received. Within the limits of changing of input power (12...13) dB the reduction by IMI is (1...6)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">A</sub>6. By numerical modeling possibility of decreasing by IMI with simultaneous increase of efficiency is shown.

articleTitle: Design of nonelectrode microwave-biased radiation detectors
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Actual ways of development of measuring microwave resonant systems with contactless inclusion of a sensor sensitive to ionizing radiation fulfilled from wide-gap compound semiconductor such as CdTe (CdZnTe) are offered. The numerical modeling and optimization of several kinds of such resonant systems has allowed approaching to a constructional design of effective radiating semiconductor microwave-biased sensors. It is expected, that the sensitivity of sensors being under consideration will not depend on capacity of absorbed doze of radiation. The most satisfactory detecting device is toroidal resonator, in capacitance backlash of which the sensor sensitive to radiation is installed, where the maximal intensity of electrical field with a high degree of uniformity takes place.

articleTitle: Band-pass characteristics of coupled sector double-gaps cavities system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of experimental investigations of influence of size and shapes of a coupled slot on band-pass characteristics of coupled sector double-gaps cavities system of multiple-beam klystron. It is shown that the coupling slot of round shape is the most optimal on a passband width for considered resonant system.

articleTitle: To the 70-year anniversary of Lev Ivanovich Tsvetkov
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Ivanovich Tsvetkov Lev was born on November 4, 1938 in Kineshma of Ivanovo region. He graduated from the Radio Technical Faculty of the Moscow Aviation Institute in 1963. A brief professional biography is provided.

articleTitle: Space research in Kharkiv Radiophysical Observatory of V. N. Karazin National University
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Radio instrumentation is developed for a remote probing of the near-Earth environment (MF radar, spaced-antenna drift radar, HF Doppler radar, differential navigation-satellite radiobeacon receivers, digisonde, and magnetometer). This instrumentation allows solving of a number of fundamental questions such as Sun-Earth connections and applied research of the following problems: ionosphere and disturbance modeling, a monitoring of the near-Earth environment, the earthquake predictions and the forecasting of a radio propagation.

articleTitle: Analysis of time synchronization protocols for NGN
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper basic protocols of the time synchronization for NGN are presented. It is an analysis for using GPS/GLONASS navigation systems (reference signal).

articleTitle: QAM64 modem with 155 Mbit/sec transmission speed
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The technical decisions have been applied in the process of realization of a modem with QAM64 modulation and data transmission rate of 155 Mbit/sec are considered.

articleTitle: Accounting of spatial quantization at simulation of metallic and semiconductor single-electron transistors
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: With the use of the proposed model an importance of an accounting of spatial quantization for calculation of current-voltage diagram of metallic and semiconductor single-electron transistors even with one island for achievement of good agreement with experimental data at low temperatures was shown.

articleTitle: Investigation of coupling coefficients of stripline resonators in the filter based on suspended substrate
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Coupling coefficients' expressions of resonators of miniaturized stripline filter construction on suspended substrate are obtained.

articleTitle: Analog pin-attenuators update
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of analogous pin-attenuator characteristics improvement are presented in the report. Characteristics of attenuators, being successfully employed in multichannel microwave receiving equipment, are given.

articleTitle: Updating of mm-wave non-regular waveguide quasioptical systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The basic types of irregular quasioptical systems of electronics of millimetric waves are analysed. On the basis of the research the scheme of their classification is offered and the ways of the further development of nonrelativistic devices on the basis of irregular open waveguides are planned.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Possibility of using Tesla's transformer in gas-discharge visualization devices
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Integral efficiency of telecommunication network
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The developed computing method of telecommunication network working efficiency using the integral criteria of preference is considered in the article.

articleTitle: Investigation of characteristics of microwave electromagnetic waves horn radiator with curvilinear generatings shape
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of investigation of reflection factor and the radiation pattern of H-sectorial horn radiator with combined form of curvilinear generatings, received by Fourier and Rits transformation methods, working in radiation mode of the basic style of wave H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf> of a working range of feeding wave guide are given. Calculated and experimental data are compared.

articleTitle: To the 60-year anniversary of Professor Gromov Dmitriy Viktorovich
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Dmitriy Viktorovich Gromov was born on 4 May 1949 in Moscow. He graduated from the secondary school in 1966 and went up to Moscow Institute of Physics and Engineering (MIPE), Automatics & Electronics Department. After that moment his life was concerned with this educational institution. After graduation he received his CSc degree in 1983 and DSc in 2001. Since 1972 he worked in MIPE as an engineer, leading engineer, senior research fellow and leading research fellow. At present he is Professor of Electronics Department, MIPE. He was directing at defending of many CSc thesises and diplomas. A brief professional biography is provided.

articleTitle: Comfort estimation for textile materials applied at medical uniform production using radiometric method
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The estimation method of coefficient of radiation of apparel fabric in the range of mm-waves by means of high-sensitivity microwave radiometric system is suggested. It allows determining the radiating ability factor of different materials for clothes and estimating the wave component in characteristics of comfort ability of clothes.

articleTitle: Optical fiber delay line for radiosignals over 1,5–2 GHz band
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A technical decision of realization of delay line of radiofrequency signals in the range of (1,5...2) GHz by means of optic-to-electronic transduction is considered. On the basis of it the company Beta TV com produces a device ODL-100.

articleTitle: Calculation of microwave power, radiated by magnetic nanostructures into free space, waveguides, and resonators
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental investigation of microwave properties of magnetic nanostructures (MNS), biased by a DC spin-polarized current is carried out using only magneto-transport measurement (MTM) method. A possibility of direct registration of microwave power (MP) generated by MNS is considered. The MP radiated by MNS into free space, waveguides, and resonators is shown to be weak in comparison with the MP measured by MTM method.

articleTitle: Aluminum based microstrip transmission lines
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of applicability of aluminum oxide technology for development of communication elements of UHF- range devices was carried out. The availability of application of microstrip transmission lines based on aluminum films, located on aluminum substrates with the anode dielectric layer was estimated. The important argument towards the use of the aluminum bases is maximum power, which might be transmitted via the microstrip transmission lines in the continuous mode due to satisfactory heat sinking. The practical realization of the microstrip UHF-device is presented on the example of 3 cm oscillator on the basis of Gunn diode.

articleTitle: Influence of design and technological factors on radiation stability of bipolar and MDS integration chips
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Information about destabilizing influence of radiation on operational integrity of hi-tech bipolar integrated circuits and MDS-circuits is presented. Experimentally received data of sensibility to ionization radiation IC, produced by means of five different technologies.

articleTitle: Electron-optical system for orotron with permanent magnets
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of simulation of a new electron optics system, forming high-current sheet electron beam for power orotron, integrated with permanent magnets, are presented. Transversally magnetized rectangle magnets are installed in the plane, and resonant system might be mounted in a direction perpendicular to that of the plane. The electron gun and collector are positioned in inner cavities of pole pieces and are shielded of a magnetic field. The gun makes the sheet electron beam with a linear compression 5, transversal dimensions in a channel 0.1 times 14 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, current - 2.8 A and current density 200 A/mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. In the collector the divergent beam is formed to decrease heating density on the surface. The anode voltage - 6 kV, focusing magnetic field -6 kGs in the pole gap 29 mm.

articleTitle: Two channel AC amplifier with antiphase control of transfer factor
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: As a part of the Technology of State Unitary Enterprise ldquoscientific-production enterpriserdquo pulsar the managed architecture of AC amplifier is designed with two channels, whose voltage transfer coefficients change in antiphased manner. The device is low-voltage and it can be done in the SiGe-technology.

articleTitle: Organization of dynamic group microcell for mm-wave broadband radio access networks
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The formation algorithm of a dynamic group microcell for broadband radio access systems of a millimetric range is offered. The algorithm responds to change of operating conditions of a network and mobility of users by traffic redistribution.

articleTitle: Experimental research of casual discontinuities having effect on attenuation in slow wave structure such as slotted-ridge waveguide
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of an experimental research of dependence of attenuation in the slotted-ridge waveguide from casual discontinuities are presented. Considerable influence of discontinuities on dispersion of attenuation factor near the shortwave boundary of a comb and growth of losses are revealed with the increase of dimension limits.

articleTitle: Electron current densities at transition through non-stationary magnetic tunnel junction
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Tunneling of electrons through a non-stationary magnetic tunnel junction in approximation of small amplitude of a variable electric field is investigated. Characteristic curves of active and reactive parts of high-frequency electron current density versus the applied constant bias voltage are considered.

articleTitle: Radiation field of H-plane sectorial horn
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The relations for radiation field of H-plane sectorial horn is deduced, in which amplitude-phase allocation on cylindrical aperture is used. The errors, which appear when we use different approximations during analyzing horn with flat aperture, are avoided. Thanks to this fact the radiation field of horn is calculated more precisely.

articleTitle: High efficient MSM-photodetectors
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The design principles and technology of high-efficient MSM-photodiode structures based on nanoscale metallic gratings which are used both as a tool for efficient light confinement and the photocarriers' collection are developed.

articleTitle: Receiver module for passive imaging system in 3 mm waves band
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The not expensive radiometric module have been created in 3-mm wave band for an array receiver of the passive imaging system. The module contains a single amplifying microcircuit and low-barrier Shottky diode as a detector. The module operated in frequency band (86...95) GHz and had temperature sensitivity 15 mK/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> in the total power mode.

articleTitle: P-cycle-method application for reservation in bus networks of mobile communication
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Redundancy scheme based on P-cycle, ensuring the formation of protective circuits in the bus networks of mobile operators, which require 20% less of network capacity in comparison with the classical ring redundancy, when recovery time of 50 ms is constant, is selected.

articleTitle: Reaction of blood-vascular system and hormone level in blood serum of rats subjected to electromagnetic field of cell phone (900 MHz)
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of long-lived electromagnetic emission of cellular communication (900 MHz, 14 days for 8 hours per day with a break at 1 hour) on a condition of system of blood and endocrine systems of male rats at age of 2 month in various terms after an irradiation was investigated. The high sensitivity of different and diverse types of leucocytes and the level of hormones of adrenal cortex (corticosterone) and sexual glands (testosterone) of rats-males to electromagnetic influence is revealed.

articleTitle: Possibility of bioactive substance sterilization using low power electromagnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A circle of problems and positive tendencies in the area of analysis of realization mechanisms of medicinal effect of electromagnetic radiation taking into account synergetic effects are considered.

articleTitle: Quality indicators optimization in transceiving device of wireless communication system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Theory of an optimization of devices and schemes of telecommunication systems, applied in modern software is considered; an optimization of a transceiver by following criteria is obtained: the transmitter by the target values of a signal strengthening, a noise factor, and the receiver by the error vector magnitude (EVM).

articleTitle: High conductive composites (diamond-silicon carbide) for heat sinking in microwave electronics
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Using the computer simulation it has been shown that diamond-silicon carbide composites have thermal conductivity 1.5...2 times greater than copper. The diamond-SiC composites with thermal conductivity (500...600) W/m K have been developed. Heat sinks of complex shape and large size for microwave techniques have been created.

articleTitle: Digital DVB-T broadcasting: Subscriber receivers
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analysis of results of the general design of the digital television broadcasting systems has been presented. Both study and test results of the obtained and developing user devices (set-top-boxes) have been shown. Single-frequency synchronous DVB-T broadcasting zones with Nos. 70 & 74 using MPEG-4 (Moving Picture Expert Group and associated audio) transport streams and QAM-64 modulation in Odessa regions have been described. As per results of complex study an optimal variant of the set-top-box for the digital DVB-T broadcasting signal receiving has been chosen for implementation in series production based on domestic radioelectronics industry.

articleTitle: Investigation of radiation-stable elements of CMOS VLSI on SOI substrates
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental technique and influence of gamma irradiation on electrical characteristics of test elements (resistors, diodes, MOS transistors) fabricated in SOI structures are presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of technological errors at production of rectangular resonance microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The analysis of errors of technological sizes of metallization of working surface of rectangular resonance single-element microstrip antenna and relative inductivity of its plate is conducted in the present work. Connection of these errors is routed with the antenna resonance frequency error.

articleTitle: Influence of conductor curvature upon its directional characteristics in the far- and near-field zones
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In approximation of the given current distribution it has been suggested a solution considering the influence of curvature of the circular loop antennas upon their directional characteristics.

articleTitle: Thermal processes effecting upon waveform shaping in autodyne gunn diode oscillators
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main factor influencing on system readiness time after power applying is the oscillator temperature variation due to self-heating of the oscillator diode. It is known that oscillator heating at its start leads to active and reactive conductance variation of the diode owing to which the amplitude and frequency variations occur as well as the respective differential parameters of diode about the steady-state. These variations influence upon the auto-detection and autodyne amplification factors as well as on the autodyne frequency deviation and the energy potential. Since it is impossible to eliminate completely this phenomenon, we must take it into account at development of each SRR.

articleTitle: Millimeter band surveillance autodyne radar
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The principals of the autodyne short range surveillance radar for object detection on distances from several to hundred meters are considered in this paper. The description of the flow chart, main parameters and results of testbed model examination are given.

articleTitle: Cherenkov's relativistic high-current oscillators with irregular corrugation
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On basis of a nonlinear model of relativistic TWT and BWO on irregular hollow waveguides taking into account both propagating, and supercritical waves and finite conductivity of metal walls, the optimization problem of an irregular waveguide profile of the new-type superpower Cherenkov oscillator with a cathode filter-groove had been solved. It is showed that the efficiency of this microwave oscillator can reach (45...60)% at current of the electron beam about 2000 A.

articleTitle: Power transducers for slotted-guide converters of microwave band
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A design of compact wideband detector head for slotted-guide measuring converters is suggested. The results of experimental researches of gain-frequency characteristic of the head are given.

articleTitle: Opportunity of wideband amplification in devices with secondary emission
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A promising approach (called as alenotron) to wideband amplification in a device based on secondary emission is considered. Numerical simulation has demonstrated stable operation of the tube at large coupling of input cavity with the signal source. A new design of the travelling wave alenotron is proposed.

articleTitle: Highly stable 8 mm-waves noise signal source for adjustment of RATAN-600
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On basis of MMIC's the highly stable noise signal source is developed for autocollimation adjustment of RATAN-600 radio telescope. In operating frequency band (31.3...37.3) GHz total noise signal power is 1.8 mW. Spectral noise density is 0.3 mW/GHz.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of relay lines modernization in Ukraine
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A report is devoted to the ways of solution of a problem of transmission of information in digitalised form under the main, area and local directions on the territory of Ukraine.

articleTitle: Digital images processing and transmission in the university microsatellite
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The block diagrams of the digital image processing and transmission subsystem are presented. CMOS-sensor for image capture is used. The matroid correcting codes and coded modulation are applied. Simulink-model of the imager is elaborated, which allows determining the coding gain, equal to 5.4 dB, for admissible error probability, equal to 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-6</sup>. This coding gain allows decreasing the power consumption of the high-frequency transmitter of micro-satellite in 3.46 times.

articleTitle: Forming of porous alumina with tubular structure by anodizing in meniscal region
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A simple method to fabricate a porous alumina layer at high forming current densities has been developed. This method allows carrying an anodic process of aluminium film dipping into the electrolyte in the meniscal part with forming current density up to 1500 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and anodising rate up to 70 mum/min. The structure of the porous alumina formed has been found to be self-organized nanotube cells for anodizing current densities more than 100 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Towards development of Web applications based on user interface services — a requirement analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In modern Web applications Web services are often used to encapsulate business logic to enable their reuse. By contrast User Interfaces are usually hand-crafted because standardized models for dynamic integration or reuse of UI components do not exist. We address this issue with an approach providing the dynamic and context-aware composition of User Interfaces based on exchangeable and customizable User Interface Services (UIS), which encapsulate UI parts. The central contribution of this paper is the discussion of the requirements for a runtime environment, which provides the novel approach of UI composition based on UIS.

articleTitle: Transformation of Gaussian beam polarization by metamaterial layer
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Polarization characteristics of the Gaussian beam that scattered on the left-handed material uniform plain layer are investigated. Opportunity of the transformation of the incident wave beam polarization into plane and circular one is shown.

articleTitle: Microwave sensor application for definition of leather materials' properties
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The humidity detector of leather on the basis of a method of reflected electromagnetic wave is developed. A number of studies by convention of properties of leather materials with the help of the sensor of ultrahigh frequency were carried out.

articleTitle: Wireless covert communications with limitation of UWB noise signals spectrum
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The experimental and design characteristics of ultra-wideband wireless covert communications with low power spectral density of noise continuous waveforms are presented.

articleTitle: A principle of millimeter-wave magnetrons design
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A concept of constructing of magnetrons of a millimeter-wave pi - fnd non p - mode are considered. The perspectives of developing of short-wave magnetrons are presented.

articleTitle: Influence of semiconductor surface potential on the efficiency of conducting capacity in Me/n-GaAs contacts with Shottky barrier
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The three assessment criterions of influence of an irregularity of a potential of a semiconductor surface on the efficiency of metal-semiconductor contacts with Shottky barrier were defined during the investigation. The principles of definition and methods of evaluation of efficiency of path of current flow in the metal-semiconductor contacts with Shottky barrier were developed.

articleTitle: Transition radiation spectra control
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The transition radiation (TR) theory of electron bunches passing through diaphragms of different geometries is developed. The induced charges and currents in the conductive diaphragms, generated by electron bunches, are the basis of this theory. The important role of grounding points of diaphragms is shown. Possibility of control of TR spectra and TR polar patterns is studied. The new design of diaphragms - double diaphragms is proposed. TR spectra are calculated when electron bunches pass through double diaphragm system.

articleTitle: Efficient simulation of numerical models for semiconductor devices
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A numerical simulation of semiconductor devices is an important information source of physics of processes flowing in them. Modern computers make available the modeling of structures, extraordinarily difficult for an analysis by other methods. For example, researches of operating regimes of Gunn diodes near-critical, for example, with a development of impact ionization in a traveling domain of a strong field. Practical information and recommendations following from the experience got while programming of mathematical models of these devices are presented. Working knowledge of methods of a program optimization and taking account of the features of processors, an application of modern development tools in combination with introduction of multigrid methods in the tasks of numerical modeling of semi-conductor devices allows effective solving of problems of a high dimensionality, utilizing of resources of modern multicore processors with a maximal efficiency, and combining of different levels of physical detailing in a single numerical model.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis of resonance frequency error in rectangular microstrip emitter
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The statistical analysis of error of resonance frequency of rectangular microstrip emitter of array is conducted in the present paper. The method of definition of adequate technological tolerances is presented on a probabilistic criterion at making the microstrip emitters (MSE) of microstrip arrays.

articleTitle: Microwave complex for the measurement of anisotropic dielectrics' parameters
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A measurement complex is developed which exhibits the following characteristics: availability of low-level microwave power used for the measurements. This feature renders possible nondestructive testing of the required parameters. High speed of both gaging and the sample changing. Ability of full automatic performance and inclusion into production runs. It can be used to carry out the following measurements of: permittivity of isotropic dielectrics. Permittivity of tensor components of anisotropic dielectrics. Losses of electromagnetic energy. Principal directions and optical axes of monaxonic and biaxial crystals.

articleTitle: Radio telescope RT-2 for Solar Service in SRI CrAO
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The schematic and design solutions are briefly described at creation of the new RT-2 radio telescope of Solar Service being under construction in the radio astronomy laboratory of CrAO Research Institute (Crimea, v. Katsively).

articleTitle: Diodes with intervalley transfer on the basis of A3B5 nitride semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The frequency and power capabilities of Gunn diodes based upon nitride semiconductors A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sub> including variband semiconductor are evaluated using two-temperature model of intervalley electron transfer (IET). Availability of nitride semiconductors in TED's is considered.

articleTitle: Photoluminescence of porous anodic alumina films with terbium incorporated by dipping
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Luminescent structures based on porous anodic alumina (PAA) of (3...50) mum thickness, comprising trivalent terbium ions within the pore channels, have been synthesised by dipping in salt solutions with the following thermal treatment at (200...600)degC. The photoluminescence of the structures has been examined. It has been revealed that luminescence intensity increases with the increase of PAA thickness. However, the maximum anisotropy of luminescence along the pore channels has been observed for PAA of 10 mum thickness.

articleTitle: Injected charge distribution in thin films of polymethylmethacrylate
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A possibility of application of an scanning electron microscope for injection of the charge into thin films of the polymethylmethacrylate (PMMA) located on well spending substrates is observed. Resolution capability of this structure depends on proximity effect of an electron beam. And this effect must be estimated. For this estimation an analytical model combining small-angle and diffusive approximations of initial Boltzmann equation is proposed.

articleTitle: The history of Special Design Bureau of television equipment at Simferopol PC «Foton»
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Presented in this paper is the history of Special Design Bureau (SDB) of television equipment at Simferopol PC "Foton" (the end of sixties - nineties), which has been leading in the field of creation of complex points for reception and processing of TV signals and closed-circuit television survey systems. Brief analysis of SDB activity and biographies of SDB heads (director - Yu. I. Kodzayev and chief engineer V. G. Buryalov) are given.

articleTitle: Hardware and software methods applied for high-speed digital receivers design
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main circuits of the programmed measuring equipment are experimentally investigated. Effective solution is possible with the use of analogue sharing of quadrature components of a signal on a rather high frequency of 2nd IF, with the use of modern integral quadrature demodulators and of a measuring path, regarding suppression of undesirable products of conversion and elimination of distinction of parameters of quadrature channels by digital methods.

articleTitle: Narrowband stripline filter on suspended substrate
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method of decreasing of interaction between stripline resonators on a suspended substrate that allows reducing sizes of narrowband filters on their base is proposed.

articleTitle: Microstrip photonic crystals and their application for polar liquids measurement
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Computer simulation and experimental investigation of frequency dependences of transmission coefficient and radiant reflectance of microstrip photonic crystals have been performed in the frequency band from 0 till 20 GHz. The measuring method of parameters of liquids has been implemented. Values of complex permittivity for several liquids have been obtained.

articleTitle: Microwave discharge in argon-sulphur mixture in highly effective light source with low feeding power
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The light source is developed on the basis of the microwave discharge in argon-sulphur mixture with high efficiency 85 lm/W ldquofrom the socketrdquo and the spectral characteristics close to characteristics of the Sun. The distinctive feature of the source is low feeding microwave power (220 W).

articleTitle: Cold starting of a magnetron with cold secondary-emission cathode using external UHF signal
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Auto-oscillation excitation by external UHF signal is studied. Conditions of specified mechanism implementation are defined. Comparison of numerical modeling results and experimental data, obtained for millimeter wavelength band magnetrons, is presented.

articleTitle: Influence of interface fractal geometry on anomalous behaviour of volt-ampere characteristic of metal-semiconductor contacts with Shottky barrier
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: With the use of a term of fractal surfaces there was showed that real metal-semiconductor interfaces with Shottky barrier had been provided with a fractal geometry that in a local approximation had influenced greatly on a behavior of static volt ampere characteristics of metal-semiconductor contacts with Shottky barrier, exerting in an anomalous increase of direct currents, a decrease of series resistance, a barrier height and an increase of factor of perfectness with a decrease of a diameter of contacts.

articleTitle: Microwave modules of low noise amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of design of RF-modules of low noise amplifiers working over the bandwidth (1,5...8,0) GHz are presented. The design and the basic RF-parameters are described.

articleTitle: Problems of wideband waveguide-slot antennas design
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Physical limits of the operational frequency band of slotted waveguide antennas are studied. It is shown that by using both conventional longitudinal slots and sub-arraying techniques it is possible to reach the relative bandwidth of about 15%. These results are illustrated by the development of genuine slotted waveguide antenna that operates in the X-band and forms the beam of 4degtimes6deg with the gain of about 30 dB.

articleTitle: Radially two-layered sphere as permittivity sensor of the surroundings
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The availability of a radially two-layered sphere resonator as a permittivity sensor of surroundings is studied. In centimetric wave band, the numerical calculations of the resonator with a quartz inner layer and a polikor external layer are made at its placement into different surroundings. It is shown that the sensitivity of the frequency variation to the permittivity variation of surroundings is determined by the external layer thickness.

articleTitle: Measurement of microwave device noise figure
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The main methods of measurement of noise figure of microwave devices are reviewed. The new possibilities of the spectrum analyzer CK4-Belan 32 are shown.

articleTitle: Conduction error reducing at power FET's linear model extraction
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The simple method of error reduction of contacting in the process of regenerating of analog circuits of power FETs is presented. The technique is based on the measuring operation of the same transistor in 50 Ohm line and than in the matching circuit with the specified impedance.

articleTitle: Wave interference effect on the shape of solar microwave bursts
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Scintillation of a radio signal passing through solar corona is considered. The expression describing a time profile of these scintillations on the basis of multibeam propagation of radio waves is derived. It is determined that the time profile of scintillations caused by multibeam propagation may appear as impulses of emission or absorption or may have sawtooth form. The assuming of the specific emission source features is not the only way to explain the shape of impulses, since the effect of multibeam propagation of radio waves through solar corona and interplanetary space yields a simple explanation of the phenomenon discussed.

articleTitle: Microwave multipolar model of branching corridor radio channels with operating Wi-Fi system inside a building
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Experimental research of radio-waves attenuation in several corridors of KhNURE main building forming T-connection has been done. The approximate method for calculation of radio-waves attenuation level in corridor wave channels by means of KhNURE Wi-Fi model and a package of applied programs Microwave Office has been developed.

articleTitle: Topology control process in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A control procedure of topology for wireless sensor network is considered, consisting in the use of rule database for minimization of power consumption by batteries.

articleTitle: Investigation of phase transition in germanium-silicate glasses formed as the result of oxidation of Ge-doped polycrystalline silicon
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The process of formation and properties of Ge-silicate glasses (GSG) in the process of oxidation of the Ge-doped nanostructured polycrystalline silicon films (NSF PCS) has been investigated. The dependences of heating effects in the process of linear heating of grinded GSG are shown.

articleTitle: Structure of films obtained as the result of oxidation and thermal treatment of nanostructured polycrystalline silicon doped by germanium
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The process of formation and properties of germanosilicate glass (GSG) films in the process of oxidation of nanostructured polycrystalline silicon doped by germanium films is investigated.

articleTitle: Increasing SaaS possibilities by using computation clouds
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Analysis of realization of functions of interoperability of SaaS applications by the use of `computation clouds' has been carried out.

articleTitle: Kaleidoscopic type wave splitter invariants
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Invariant properties of kaleidoscopic type wave bunch splitter are investigated. The possibility of back radiation reflection was shown when wave bunches illuminate two sides of kaleidoscopic element.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of microwave heating of oil stratum
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In a mathematical model of microwave heating of oil stratum the dependence of oil physical parameters versus temperature was taken into account. The model includes a system of two-dimensional interconnected equations of an electromagnetic wave propagating and heat transfer. A numerical simulation of microwave heating stratum of Russian oilfield was carried out with finite element method. Optimal parameters of electromagnetic radiation source were obtained.

articleTitle: Oscillations interaction in cross-field systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Theoretical description of different nature of oscillations exciting in systems of cross fields and their influence on output spectrum was observed. A reasonable agreement of experimental and theoretical results was deduced.

articleTitle: Peniotron and large-orbit gyrotron at H41-mode: Efficiency benchmarking
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of optimization for efficiency of peniotrons and large-orbit gyrotrons at working mode H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">41</sub> of a circular waveguide are represented. It is shown, that at the compared level of magnetic B<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>, the peniotron considerably surpasses the large-orbit gyrotron: the peniotron's maximum efficiency reaches 50 % at the amplification band on half power 6.5 %, but the gyrotron has maximum efficiency of 14.5 % at band 2.5 %.

articleTitle: The influence of inversion channel defect on silicon MOS-structure current parameters
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The inversion channel defect influence on silicon MOS-structure current parameters were studied. It is shown, that basic influence on these one render dislocations presented in the inversion channel of MOS-structure.

articleTitle: Wide-band chaotic oscillations control in electron beam with virtual cathode in non-uniform magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The report deals with study of the virtual cathode (VC) formation processes in the external non-uniform magnetic field of periodic focusing system (MPFS). It is shown that there is possibility of the control of power and spectrum of VC generation by the variation of characteristics of MPFS.

articleTitle: Antenna synthesis on the basis of ant optimization algorithms
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Variants and results of synthesis of new designs for electrical small antennas on the basis of application of ant colony algorithms of optimization are described. For a research of parameters of the received loopback structures and unloopback vibrators MMAHA is used. An application of received geometrical forms is possible under the character of contour lines of path or slot-hole antennas or as a form-building surface of a crystal of dielectric resonator antennas.

articleTitle: 2 Watt X-ku band Quasi-MMIC transistor amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of a development and an experimental investigation of (8...18) GHz range of Q-MMIC transistor amplifier with output power 2 Watt at 1 dB gain compression are presented. The experimental characteristics, design features and assembly technology of the manufactured amplifiers are discussed.

articleTitle: EM-waves dispersion by flat microstrip reflect array including combined radiators. Results of numerical research
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: On the basis of a method of integral equations a mathematical model of reflector antenna array from longitudinal and transversal microstrip radiators is built. Novelty of the offered mathematical model consists in the adequate description of influence of a stripline feeder on characteristics of the microstrip array. It is reached by the full-wave modeling of a microstrip radiator of the phased antenna array and a part of a stripline feeder which directly adjoins to the antenna element of an array.

articleTitle: UHF power amplifiers with wide-gap MESFET
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calculation and simulation investigation of wideband power amplifiers of class E with the use of SiC and GaN MESFETs are carried out.

articleTitle: Band-pass filter with magnetic control based on waveguide photonic structure
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A research of a band-pass peak behavior was made in a bandgap formed with a thin ferrite plate of 1-d waveguide photonic structure. The possibility of controlling frequency position of band-pass peak by superposition of external magnetic field was demonstrated. It was made a proposal to use similar structures as controlled waveguide band-pass filters in millimetric, submillimetric and terahertz ranges.

articleTitle: The features of partial reflection signals, radionoises and electron density variations in the regional middle latitude D-region during five solar eclipses
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The changes of the partial reflection signals, radio-noises at (2,2...2,4) MHz and the electron density variations in the middle latitude D-region before, during and after five solar eclipses are investigated by the partial reflection technique. The quasi-periodic (with periods of T ges(30...60) minutes) more than (50...100) % increase of electron density during tens of minutes was found. The estimations of the ionization rate of change were made. On the basis of the experimental data over the electron precipitation periods, stimulated by solar eclipses, corresponding fluxes were estimated, being p ~(10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> ...10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>) m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-2</sup>sec<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>.

articleTitle: The high-power gyroton on corrugated cavity
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A new type of high-power electronic device - gyroton on the basis of corrugated resonator is described. In this device spatial bunching of an electron beam does not occur; however, highly efficient conversion of power of an electron beam into power of a rotating electromagnetic field is possible. The electron beam entering the device is linear; due to its initial deviation from the axis by slowing of TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sub> wave, it than returns its longitudinal energy to the same wave with the efficiency of more than 88%.

articleTitle: Entropic-metric characteristics of astrophysical signals
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Informational-entropic and generalized metrical characteristics of solar radio-wave radiation and variable stars' signals have been determined. It is shown, that suggested new method allows classifying different types of astrophysical signals quantitatively.

articleTitle: Evolution in bus and transport networks of mobile communication
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Ways of migration of network to modern technologies were analyzed with allowance for existing network structure SDH and market requirements. Merits and demerits of perspective technologies were considered too.

articleTitle: Technological microwave plasma module for reactive-ion etching of electronic devices in dual-frequency discharge
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A design of dual-frequency plasma discharge device developed for the purposes of reactive-ion etching of materials during formation of elements of a microstructure of products of electronic technology is presented. A basis of the design forms a microwave plasmatron of a cavity type with an applicator in the form of a slotted waveguide antenna locked up in a ring. Along the axis of the microwave applicator an evacuated quartz chamber is located. Both ends of it are closed by flat electrodes of low-frequency gas-discharge gas system of a capacity type. Dual-frequency discharge is initiated in the evacuated chamber under joint action of microwave (f1 ap 2.45 GHz) and low frequency (f2 ap 1...50 kHz) of electromagnetic fields.

articleTitle: Mobile transactions organization in mobile SDR system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method of updating of software support in mobile networks based on SDR is considered. This paper represents the approach to the updating of the software of SDR systems.

articleTitle: Charging problems in mobile networks
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This paper presents the solution which is open and flexible, empowering service providers to customize and create new and innovative value-added services (VAS). The problems and lacks of rating process of current model are analyzed and the problem-solving ways are discussed.

articleTitle: Microstrip protector
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: New construction of microstrip radio pulse protection device is proposed which control element is a rectangular HTS film frame.

articleTitle: Regulation of momentary output power of magnetron operating in continuous mode (M-105, M-112 type) being a part of technological plasma unit
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of investigation of a method of regulation of instantaneous power output of a magnetron by means of changing of capacity of a condenser in a voltage doubler of high-voltage power supply of a magnetron are presented.

articleTitle: Influence of wavefront steepness on current excitations in magnetrons with second emission cathodes
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Influence of steepness of pulse edge of anode tension on a value of current of auxiliary hot cathode, necessary for activation of magnetron of 3-mm range with a secondary-emission cathode is investigated. It is shown that the value of this current considerably increases with the increase of steepness.

articleTitle: Computer-aided investigation of coaxial gyro-BWO efficiency depending on injection beam energy
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this report we obtained enhancement of gyro-BWO efficiency from up to ~30% due to profiling guiding magnetic field for a wide range of injection beam energy.

articleTitle: Simulation of carry processes and electronic properties of indium antimonide semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Calculations are carried out and the fundamental characteristics causing specificity of InSb material are obtained. The computing algorithm is developed; the program of numerical modeling by a method of Monte-Carlo for devices on the basis of InSb material is designed and debugged. The obtained theoretical results give possibility for creation of a wide scale of InSb semiconductor devices with improved frequency characteristics reaching quasi-optical range of frequencies.

articleTitle: Theoretical and numerical investigation of external noises influencing backward wave tube dynamics
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This report deals with the theoretical investigation of external noises influence on the backward wave tube (BWT) dynamics in the context of simple klystron model. It was shown that noise influence cite to the change of bifurcation value of control parameter.

articleTitle: Chaotic MW pulse generator on the basis of amplifier klystron and nonlinear magnetostatic wave delay line
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this paper the experimental study of the self-generated stationary sequence of the chaotic MW pulses in the active ring with the multi-cavity klystron and nonlinear magnetostatic surface wave delay line is carried out.

articleTitle: 10 W C-band wideband power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Results of a design and an experimental investigation of 4-8 GHz amplifier with output power upper 8 W at 1 dB gain compression are presented in this article. Results of modeling, experimental characteristics, and construction and scheme features of amplifier are obtained. Ultra-low gain ripple (1 dB) and high PAE (22...28%) are demonstrated.

articleTitle: Design and realization of printed antenna arrays for radio link point-multipoint X-band
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The printed antennas are actually in tremendous growth; their use is widespread in all areas of telecommunications where their low cost and congestion are advantages. Thus, we present in this paper the application of these antennas in the domain of radio link X band. Two antennas with directive (high gain) and sector (large) radiations are made and tested.

articleTitle: UHF dual class E power amplifier with load network in series to switch
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The dual class E amplifier with series to switch both capacitor and inductor is presented. The values of elements of amplifier load network are determined. A method of output transmission-lines of amplifier design is also presented. The method is proved to satisfy experience with good accuracy.

articleTitle: Automated system of quasioptical polarimetric micro-compact range
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The automation system of quasioptical polarimetric micro-compact range (PMCR) is developed, which realizes the method of quasi-optical waveguide modeling (QWM). The operation algorithm of automation system is described briefly.

articleTitle: Determination of troposphere refraction and reflecting layers by variation of satellite signal level using spectral estimation methods
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A method of estimation of tropospheric refraction based on a spectral estimation of amplitude of transmitted radiation of satellite is proposed. A possibility of estimation of number of sources forming a field in a receiving point, its coordinates related to topography and inversion layers in the troposphere is shown.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Figure of Merit for Reentrant Cylindrical Cavities
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Approximate formulas on base of simple parameters of L-C equivalent circuit for calculation of the characteristic impedance (rho = R/Q) for the reentrant cylindrical cavities can be used in microwave devices of klystron type as figure of merit (FOM), but they are not sufficiently accurate. Particularly low accuracy of calculation we can get if the drift tubes have a small diameter and a great height of the cavity.

articleTitle: Comparing simulation methods for millimeter waves scattering by nonspherical scatterers
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The comparison of calculations of the scattering properties of non-spherical form for the millimetre band on the base of T-matrix method and discrete sources method was carried out.

articleTitle: Nonequilibrium boundary effects in quantum devices
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Demonstrated that quantum devices functioning by using of non-equilibrium boundary effects may to reach characteristics comparable with characteristics of traditional devices of microelectronics.

articleTitle: Service orientation in middleware components for scalable service marketplaces
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The purpose of marketplaces in an economic sense is the offering of a venue for selling and buying goods. On the Internet, virtual marketplaces for trading goods have also been known since the 1990s. More recently, the marketplace idea has been extended towards the exchange of highly-specialised, custom services which are technically implemented as redistributable Web services. As opposed to tradable goods which are sold at a discrete point in time, the service marketplace retains its functionality beyond the purchase through continuous contracting and management of services. This additional activity increases the amount of required resources. For a scalable exchange between thousands of users, the underlying system and middleware thus needs to adhere to scalability principles known from service-oriented architectures. This paper confirms the idea of representing the middleware as a set of distributed platform services which can themselves be offered on service marketplaces.

articleTitle: Inverted strip dielectric guide with metal plane
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The experimental results of waveguiding regime in an inverted strip dielectric guide with a metal plane are presented. The excitation technique is investigated.

articleTitle: Forced oscillations in dielectric sphere at excitation by ring modulated current
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Oscillation excitation by an azimuthally modulated electrical current that flows in sphere equatorial plane is studied in isotropic spherical dielectric resonator placed into isotropic medium. It is shown this current excites E and H modes. If the frequency of ring current radiation coincides with the frequency of eigenmode, there is an amplitude resonance in the oscillating system.

articleTitle: Parametrization of quasi-optical irregular waveguides with quadratic correction
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The questions of the choice of geometrical and electro dynamical parameters for irregular quasi-optical waveguides with mirrors of quadratic correction, which recently have become widely used in electronics EHF, are described in this article.

articleTitle: Non-Faradaic impedance sensors for bacteries detection
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Sensitivity of non-Faradaic impedance sensors for bacterial detection E.coli in Kessler culture medium is investigated. It is shown that for reduction of time of bacterial detection in the range (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>...10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>) CFU/ml non-Faradaic impedance sensors with electrodes covered by a thin film of nanoporous anodic aluminum oxide.

articleTitle: Influence of power supply on frequency distortions in magnetron
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This report presents the results of an experimental investigation of output spectra of stationary low-voltage magnetrons K and Ku bands. The behavior of a characteristic curve of frequency of an output signal of a magnetron versus parameters of source power is investigated. The ways of reduction of frequency dancing in the magnetron are shown (less than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup>).

articleTitle: Legitimate signal separation using stochastic resonance method
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Possibility of application of stochastic resonance (SR) method for short realizations of the casual process, which is the additive sum of a harmonious signal and normal noise, is considered. Results of calculation of the signal/noise relation at the output of the nonlinear device with SR, depending on frequency of a harmonious signal, are resulted for various values a signal/noise at the input.

articleTitle: Hardness of microwave amplifiers based on silicon-germanium heterostructures
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Researches have been conducted regarding the influence of ionizing radiation on the properties of monolithic ICs in microwave amplifiers on SiGe heterojunction transistors.

articleTitle: Circularly polarized horn antenna with minimized effective scattering area
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: A design of a pyramidal horn antenna of circular polarization with minimized effective area of scattering is offered. A method of excitation of waves of circular or elliptic polarization by their decomposition into two orthogonal waves of the basic orthogonal type H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> is developed. The basic waves are excited by two longitudinal slots in the ribs of the horn mouth. Diminishing of the effective area of scattering is achieved by absorption of waves of the highest types excited by a falling wave.

articleTitle: 2–4 GHz 50 W and 100 W wideband GaAs transistor power amplifier units
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of a development and an experimental investigation of 50 Watt and 100 Watt wideband of units of GaAs transistor amplifiers of a range 2 - 4 GHz are presented. The units are based on serial wideband GaAs transistor amplifiers. There have been two units developed. A PM24-C8 times 2 unit consists of two serial wideband amplifiers PM24-C8 with identical gain-frequency and phase difference characteristics and two tandem couplers. The photograph of PM24-C8 times 2 is presented on Fig. 4. A PtVI24-C8 times 4 unit consists of four amplifiers PM24C8 and six tandem couplers. The picture of PM24-C8times4 is presented. The results of measurements of output power in a linear mode and saturation power of units. Modules of resulting parameters are presented. The size of PM24-C8 times 2 unit is 395 times 180 times 155 millimeters and size of PM24-C8 times 4 unit is 395 times 180 times 280 millimeters.

articleTitle: Compensatory properties of traveling-wave resonators with active elements
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Characteristics of waveguide traveling-wave resonators are considered and analyzed in the course of inclusion in their ring circuit of such elements as resonant measuring converters with different brought losses, narrow-band and broadband amplifiers with different gain and bands of gain frequencies. Possibilities of loss compensation brought by resonant converters are estimated when their telling impact on AFC TWR with active elements is constant.

articleTitle: Influence of superluminality in Gaussian beam on Q-factor of the open resonator modes
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: For the two-dimensional open resonator (OR) with cylindrical mirrors in strict statement of a problem of diffraction is explored an influence of Gaussian beam parameters on Q-factor of the fundamental and higher modes. It is established, that the superluminality in Gaussian beam reduces in a raise of Q-factor of the OR modes in comparison with traditional estimations. For the fundamental mode the discrepancy in Q-factor makes up to 2%, and for higher modes reaches 20%, that it is necessary to take into account at electromagnetic measuring.

articleTitle: Scattering properties of vegetative environment in UHF range
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The theoretical analysis of scattering properties of unit volume of the vegetative environment with parameters, characteristic for a crone in absence of foliage was carried out. Elements of environment were modeled by dielectric cylinders of finite-length with a randomly orientation in space. Angular function of distribution of intensity of scattering radiation was executed and the comparative analysis for various frequencies of UHF of a range and parameters of environment was considered.

articleTitle: Inhibition of physical jitter in optical communication systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The method for improving quality of service QoS (Quality of Service) in optical communication systems through the suppression of physical jitter using a cylindrical lens and reducing of the value BER (bit error rate) is proposed.

articleTitle: The influence of X-valley barrier height at calculation of IV-characteristics of GaAs/AlAs based RTD
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The influence of X-valley of conduction band on electrical characteristics of RTD based on GaAs/AlAs was investigated. A good agreement of results with experimental data was obtained.

articleTitle: Aluminum oxide technology for creation of mm-band devices on the basis of nanoporous oxide
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Methods of engineering of devices of a millimeter-wave on aluminium substrates with a dielectric layer on the basis of nanoporous oxide of aluminium received by electrochemical oxidation are developed. With the use of various software packages low-noise amplifiers of a millimeter-wave are developed. Amplitude-frequency and noise characteristics of developed devices are investigated.

articleTitle: Business processes modelling, transformation and realization
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Brief characteristics of business processes (BP) is made, BP conceptual and mathematical models are suggested as one of basics for their analysis and realization methods development, which includes BP modeling and analysis, BP model transformation to computational processes (CP) model, and CP realization. The suggested models and algorithms allows to raise the efficiency of BP modeling, analysis, realization and reengineering, improving the technology of Internet-based information system (IBIS) development and reduce human factor effect on development process.

articleTitle: Microwave photonic crystals with transmittance controlled by PIN-diodes
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The control of transmittance in the range up to 30 dB in low-loss transmission window of photonic crystal in X-band has been obtained by means of changing of voltage on PIN-diodes in the range of (250...800) mV.

articleTitle: Prediction of radiation resistance of CMOS integrated microcircuits
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of experimental researches and the calculating-experimental method of prediction of radiation resistance of logic CMOS integrated microcircuits at influence of fast electrons are submitted.

articleTitle: Electrically-tunable microwave attenuator on the basis of ferrite-piezoelectric layered structure
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: One of perspective directions of a solid-state electronic engineering is producing new devices on the basis of ferrite-piezoelectric materials. Design and application of new microstrip microwave attenuator are considered.

articleTitle: Focusing fields simulation in diode electron-optical system
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: Three-dimensional models of electron-optical and magnetic focusing systems are offered for determination of the inhomogeneous fields by the method of charge closeness. The design and analysis are conducted, comparing of results with experimental information and their good correlation is carried out.

articleTitle: Resonator measurements of superonductor surface impedance provided oscillations degeneration removal
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The processing technique of amplitude-frequency response (AFR) of resonators with partial removal of mode of degeneration was developed, which allows calculating of resonance frequency and quality-factor. The approach was used for data processing obtained at AFR measurement of sapphire resonator with HTS film as a key stage of determination of surface impedance.

articleTitle: Planning of 3-d generation mobile communication networks
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The methods of planning and optimization of cellular communication networks are presented. Analysis of well known program complexes of planning is performed.

articleTitle: Adaptation of conditional optimization algorithm using modified complex Box method for synthesis in electrodynamics on the basis of distributed and parallel calculations systems
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: The results of application of an effective method of a search for global extremum for a problem solution of optimization of parameters of waveguide structures by specified electrodynamics characteristics on systems of distributed and parallel calculations are presented.

articleTitle: 5 GHz wideband microstrip antenna design
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This work considers the design of a microstrip antenna for 5 GHz frequency band along with different techniques that might be used for broadening of pass bandwidth. The microstrip antenna with pass bandwidth 17,6% (at - 10 dB level of reflection index) and efficiency 61% was designed.

articleTitle: Complex two-level transistor for microwave power amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: original combined double-deck microwave FET has been realized and characterized. Power combining of two 1-Watt transistor crystals has been obtained at frequencies 3 and 6 GHz. These results verify the concept of a design of microwave IC based on two-floor parallel transistor crystal.

articleTitle: Comparing efficiency of parallel calculations in MATLAB and OpenMP
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: This article is devoted to improvement of effectiveness of IMS-platform for service provisioning at the expense of software, which uses a parallel computing. During investigations it was compared the effect of parallel computing in MATLAB environment and OpenMP libraries. Comparisons were based on solution of systems of linear equations by a method of Cramer. The comparison was performed for matrices with various sizes, and hence for a different number of iterations in the cycle.

articleTitle: Some approaches to estimation of functional condition of visual type operators using hardware-software complex
publicationTitle: 2009 19th International Crimean Conference Microwave & Telecommunication Technology
abstract: In this work we have presented methodical approach to the estimation of functional conditions of visual type operators and software-hardware complex for its realization.
